title: Commercial Lines Account Coordinator
description:
Built on meritocracy, our unique company culture rewards self-starters and those who are committed to doing what is best for our customers.

Summary:

The Commercial Lines Account Coordinator provides administrative and service support for Commercial Lines accounts by coordinating complex policy servicing activities, supporting renewal and marketing efforts, and ensuring the accuracy of policy transactions and documentation. This role serves as a technical resource for the Commercial Lines team, and supports the delivery of exceptional client service.

Essential Duties and Functions:

· Provide administrative and service support to Commercial Lines Account Managers and Producers in the day-to-day servicing of client accounts.

· Maintain accurate client and policy information within agency management systems, document management systems, and carrier platforms, ensuring all records are current and complete.

· Process policy transactions including endorsements, cancellations, reinstatements, audits, policy changes, and other servicing requests in accordance with agency and carrier procedures.

· Issue and process insurance documentation including certificates of insurance, evidence of property forms, automobile identification cards, binders, and other policy-related documents.

· Review policies, endorsements, audits, invoices, and carrier-issued documents for accuracy, completeness, and consistency with coverage requests and policy terms.

· Support renewal and marketing activities by gathering client information, updating applications, preparing underwriting documentation, obtaining required reports, and assisting with renewal submissions and proposals.

· Compile and maintain underwriting and account-related data, including loss runs, motor vehicle reports, claims information, insurance summaries, and other supporting documentation.

· Communicate with clients, carriers, and internal team members to obtain information, respond to service requests, provide status updates, and facilitate timely resolution of account-related matters.

· Assist with claims administration activities by processing claim notices, gathering documentation, monitoring claim status, and maintaining claim records as directed.

· Process and distribute policy documents and renewal materials to clients, ensuring timely delivery and appropriate follow-up on outstanding items.

· Monitor and follow up on carrier and client requests, pending transactions, direct bill renewals, audits, discrepancies, and outstanding documentation to ensure timely completion.

· Develop and maintain working knowledge of commercial insurance coverages, carrier systems, underwriting guidelines, and agency procedures to effectively support account servicing activities.

· Support client retention efforts by delivering responsive customer service, maintaining positive professional relationships, and assisting in meeting client service expectations.

· Perform general office and administrative functions including document preparation, data entry, filing, mail processing, reporting, and providing operational support as needed.


Competencies:

· Communicates Effectively – Delivers communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

· Instills Trust– Gains the confidence & trust of others through honesty, integrity & authenticity.

· Customer Focused – Builds strong relationships and delivers customer centric solutions.

· Resilience- Steps up to tackle tough assignments.

· Drives Results – Consistently achieve results through meeting timeframes.

· Drives Engagement – Helps create a positive and engaging work environment.

· Cultivates Innovation – Creates new and better ways for internal processes.

· Attracts & Develops Talent – Refer top talent and set a positive example for potential new hires.

· Decision Quality – Make good and timely decisions that drive efficient workflows.

· Mentorship – Support the growth and development of others through teamwork and knowledge sharing.

· Safety and security—the individual observes safety and security procedures and uses equipment and materials properly.


Qualifications:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


Required

· Highschool Diploma or GED

· Proficient with MS Office Suite

· Exceptional telephone demeanor

· Ability to maintain a high level of confidentiality

· Florida 4 40 Lic with 30 days of Hire

· Eligible for Florida 2 -20 License within 1 year of hire


Preferred

· 2-20 Licensed

· Associate’s or bachelor’s degree in a business or financial related discipline


Teammate Benefits & Total Well-Being

We go beyond standard benefits, focusing on the total well-being of our teammates, including:

  • Health Benefits: Medical/Rx, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Disability Insurance
  • Financial Benefits: ESPP; 401k; Student Loan Assistance; Tuition Reimbursement

  • Beyond Benefits: Paid Time Off, Holidays, Preferred Partner Discounts and more.

title: Clinical Transplant Coordinator Kidney
description:
About Solid Organ Transplant

Our system continues to expand its services in groundbreaking medicine. With over a decade of transplantation experience, we have successfully assembled a world-class team of thoracic surgeons, cardiologists, pulmonologists, anesthesiologists, nephrologists, imaging, and critical care specialists to provide care to patients with advanced heart, lung and kidney disease. Corewell Health is committed to offering these advanced levels of care to our local community and beyond.



Scope of Work


Coordinates transplantation of all recipients. Provides follow-up and care across the continuum from pre-transplant, during transplant and post transplant. Collaborates with members of the health care team to enhance patient care by developing, supporting and educating nursing staff. Makes clinical judgments based upon a synthesis of current research, concepts, principles, theories, and outcomes to solve complex problems. An integral member of a larger interdisciplinary team contributing to excellence in patient care, research and teaching.


  • Facilitates advanced nursing care for patients before and after transplantation along the continuum of outpatient to inpatient as required.
  • Coordinates evaluation process for pre-transplant patients and living donors (as applicable) to ensure effective use of hospital and/or clinical resources.
  • Assesses post-transplant and post donation (as appropriate) organ function and general health status and collaboratively determines need for additional assessment or intervention.
  • Participates in the development and implementation of protocol and standards of care for the transplant patient in collaboration with the multidisciplinary team.
  • Provides on-call coverage including coordination of activities prior to transplant, the transplantation process when a donor is available (24/7), communication between physicians, local organ procurement organization, patients/families and the medical team involved, blood bank in collaboration with the physician on-call.
  • Completes necessary documentation according to the United Network of Organ Sharing (UNOS) guidelines including listing, status changes and post-transplant/post-donation (as applicable) follow-up information.
  • Communicates with multidisciplinary team members and patients and families in a timely manner in regard to patient care/issues and to develop discharge plans for patients pre-transplant or post-transplant including referrals for necessary discharge care. Maintains patient transplant record with current data to facilitate communication.
  • Educates patients, caregivers and hospital staff along the continuum by developing patient education materials or identifying external resources that are appropriate to assist understanding of processes and procedures surrounding pre-, peri and post-transplant issues.

title: Safety Packaging Engineer
description:
French version below

Packaging Materials Safety Manager - Operations

Hello, we're L'Oréal. We're not just building brands, we're shaping how the world experiences beauty (and it takes a lot of cool jobs to do it).Intrigued? Keep reading, this might be the opportunity you've been searching for.

A Day in the Life

You lead the safety and regulatory compliance of packaging materials at global scale within our Packaging Science Center, partnering closely with R&I Safety and Regulatory teams to prevent material-formula risks.
• Steer risk management projects on packaging interactions with cosmetic and food-supplement formulas, leading toxicological and regulatory risk analyses.
• Assess innovative, sustainable packaging materials (recycled plastics, bio-based solutions) in line with our 'L'Oréal for the Future' commitments to ensure 92% of biobased packaging materials and formula ingredients are traceable and sustainably sourced.
• Collaborate with suppliers and innovation partners such as Carbios and Albéa, driving compliance with REACH, cosmetic, and food-contact regulations under our internal RPP900 standard.
• Lead material substitution initiatives for components that do not meet internal or regulatory requirements, defining preventive and corrective action plans with operational teams.
• Partner across 7 Operations métiers to communicate safety risk levels on projects, resolve operational deviations, and track supplier compliance KPIs.

We Are Looking For

You bring scientific rigour, an analytical mindset, and a proactive approach to risk management. You bring:
• Scientific Expertise: Deep background in packaging materials, packaging development, toxicology, or materials science.
• Regulatory & Safety Analysis: Proven capability navigating REACH, food-contact, and cosmetic safety frameworks, including operational deviation management.
• Cross-functional Collaboration: Track record of aligning technical stakeholders, R&I safety teams, and external suppliers on complex risk decisions.
• Continuous Improvement: Proven ability to track performance KPIs, manage non-conformity resolutions, and drive material substitutions.
• Language Skills: Fluent French and professional working proficiency in English.

What's In It For You
• A place for you to leave your comfort zone and grow beyond your potential (here, you'll be encouraged to try new things and take risks!)
• Real responsibility from day 1, there's no sitting on the sidelines at L'Oréal
• An environment where people of every ethnicity, social background, age, religion, gender and sexual orientation as well as people with disabilities are accepted, can speak up, will thrive and are celebrated!
• A place where you can contribute to something bigger

Ingénieur Expertise Packaging

Chez L'Oréal, nous ne faisons pas que créer des marques, nous façonnons la façon dont le monde vit la beauté (et il faut beaucoup de métiers formidables pour y arriver). Vous voulez en savoir plus ? Continuez à lire, c'est peut-être l'opportunité que vous attendiez.

Vos missions

Au sein du Packaging Science Center, vous pilotez la sécurité et la conformité réglementaire des matériaux de packaging à l'échelle mondiale, en lien étroit avec la R&I pour prévenir les risques d'interaction contenant-contenu. Vous serez responsable de :
• Piloter l'analyse des risques d'interaction entre matériaux d'emballage et formules cosmétiques ou compléments alimentaires, sur les plans toxicologique et réglementaire.
• Évaluer de nouveaux matériaux durables (recyclés, biosourcés), en phase avec nos engagements " L'Oréal for the Future " pour atteindre 92 % de matériaux biosourcés traçables et durables.
• Collaborer avec des partenaires industriels comme Carbios et Albéa pour garantir la conformité REACH, cosmétique et contact alimentaire selon notre standard interne RPP900.
• Diriger les projets de substitution de substances non conformes et déployer les plans d'actions correctives avec les équipes opérationnelles.

title: Senior Advisor Planning and Performance
description:
• Newly created Senior Advisor role in the Driving Regulation system
  • Make a meaningful impact on regulatory performance and delivery across New Zealand’s land transport system
  • Use your advisory, planning and coordination skills to help leaders prioritise and deliver the right work at the right time.

Te Whiwhinga mahi | The opportunity

We have an exciting opportunity for a Senior Advisor Planning and Performance to join our Planning, Performance & Improvement function in the Driving Regulation system. This role is focused on supporting leaders and teams to plan, prioritise and coordinate work, make well-informed decisions, and maintain a clear view of delivery, risks and emerging issues.If you enjoy working through complexity, providing practical advice and helping teams turn priorities into coordinated plans and action, this role offers the chance to do work with real purpose. You will work closely with operational teams, leaders and stakeholders to clarify priorities, support decision-making, strengthen delivery disciplines and help shape better regulatory outcomes for New Zealanders.


Key responsibilities include:

  • Support leaders and teams to translate strategic and regulatory priorities into clear, coordinated work plans.
  • Provide practical advice on priorities, sequencing, dependencies, risks and trade-offs to support decision-making.
  • Coordinate planning and workflow across teams, helping maintain focus on the most important work.
  • Prepare clear advice, briefings and recommendations for leaders, governance groups and operational teams.
  • Bring people and information together across teams to resolve issues and support joined-up delivery.
  • Monitor progress against plans and identify where decisions, intervention or reprioritisation may be needed.
  • Facilitate planning and prioritisation discussions that lead to clear decisions, actions and accountabilities.
  • Improve planning tools, frameworks and processes so they support effective delivery and are easy to apply.
  • Support governance, committee, forum, Ministerial, OIA and reporting requirements.

You can find out more about the role in the position description here


Ko koe tēnei | About you

We are looking for someone who brings curiosity, sound judgement, and strong advisory skills. You'll be comfortable working with a wide range of data, people, and complex or ambiguous situations bringing structure to competing priorities.While this is not a Data Analyst role, you will have the ability to interpret information, identify insights, and translate these into clear, practical advice that supports decision-making, planning the work and helping teams deliver effectively.


You will bring:

  • Experience providing high-quality advice in a regulatory, government or complex operational environment.
  • Strong planning and prioritisation skills, including the ability to turn broad priorities into practical work plans.
  • Experience coordinating work across multiple teams, functions or work programmes.
  • The ability to assess competing priorities, risks, dependencies and trade-offs and provide clear recommendations.
  • Experience supporting leaders and teams to make decisions, resolve issues and maintain delivery momentum.
  • Strong relationship and facilitation skills, with the confidence to bring people together and work constructively across organisational boundaries.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, including experience preparing advice, briefings, decision papers and governance material.
  • The ability to interpret performance information and use it to inform advice, planning and action.
  • Good judgement, initiative and a practical approach to navigating ambiguity and solving problems.
  • Working knowledge of project, programme or portfolio planning approaches would be useful.
  • A good understanding of regulatory systems, government processes or complex operational environments.

This role would suit an experienced advisor who enjoys helping leaders and teams make good decisions, establish clear priorities and turn complex work into practical, coordinated plans.


You will demonstrate knowledge of, or a willingness to gain an understanding of Te Ao Māori and promote tikanga and Te Reo Māori. You will also have knowledge of, or a willingness to gain an appreciation of Te Tiriti o Waitangi and its application in the public sector.


Mō mātou | About UsTe Rōpū Waeture | Regulatory

As the lead regulator for land transport, our purpose is to ensure the system is safe, effective, efficient and operates in the public interest. Safety is our top priority, and we are committed to reducing harm by being a firm and fair regulator, grounded in good regulatory practice and Te Ao Māori principles. We take a system view, focusing on outcomes, encouraging and educating where appropriate, and enforcing compliance when necessary.

Regulatory Planning, Performance & Improvement

Our Regulatory Planning, Performance & Improvement function plays an important role in helping the regulatory system operate well. We provide sub-system oversight, planning, performance monitoring and improvement support so regulatory teams can focus on core delivery while having the insight, tools and support they need to make good decisions and improve outcomes.


Ka whiwhi koe i te aha | What you will get in return

At NZTA, you will be part of work that matters to people, communities and the transport system across Aotearoa New Zealand. This role offers variety, purpose and the opportunity to build strong relationships while contributing to better planning, performance and improvement across a complex national regulatory system.

Along with a competitive salary package, we offer:

  • Flexible working arrangements (role dependent).
  • Career development and learning opportunities.
  • A collaborative and supportive work environment.
  • 5 weeks annual leave.
  • Income Protection and Critical Illness Insurance for permanent employees.
  • Access to a range of employee benefits and wellbeing initiatives.

If you are ready to bring your planning, performance and advisory skills to work that has real impact, we would love to hear from you. Apply today and help us support a safer, more effective and better performing land transport system for New Zealand.

15 November 2026

title: General Manager
description:
About the Job

We are seeking an experienced, hands-on General Manager to lead our Thousand Oaks location. This role owns the full performance of the location, including sales, operations, warehouse and logistics, product and inventory, people, customer experience, and financial results. It is ideal for a leader who is equally comfortable in a client meeting, on the warehouse floor, and in a P&L review, and who knows how to build a team that delivers in a high-volume, deadline-driven business.

The General Manager reports to the Regional President and partners closely with regional and corporate teams across sales, finance, HR, safety, and asset management to grow the business, deliver flawless events, and build a strong, engaged team.


What You’ll Do

  • Own the location’s P&L, including revenue, gross margin, labor, and operating expenses, and build and deliver on the annual budget and monthly forecasts.
  • Lead the sales team to grow revenue and market share across weddings, social, corporate, and large-scale events by setting targets, coaching on pipeline and pricing, and staying personally involved in key accounts and major events.
  • Build and strengthen relationships with clients, planners, venues, and vendor partners across Thousand Oaks, Ventura County, and the greater Los Angeles market.
  • Oversee all operations, including warehouse, logistics, delivery, installation, and strike, so every event is executed safely, on time, and to our quality standards.
  • Manage product and inventory performance, including availability, utilization, cleaning, maintenance, repair, and loss, and partner on purchasing, sub-rental, and disposal decisions.
  • Plan labor and scheduling to match seasonal demand while controlling overtime and labor cost.
  • Champion a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with Cal/OSHA, DOT, and fleet requirements.
  • Recruit, develop, and retain a high-performing team, hold leaders accountable for results, and build bench strength for future growth.
  • Partner with HR to ensure compliance with California employment requirements and company policy, including timekeeping, meal and rest breaks, and wage-and-hour practices.
  • Use operational and financial data to spot trends, solve problems, and improve efficiency, pricing, and the customer experience.
  • Resolve escalated customer issues quickly and professionally, protecting both the relationship and the business.
  • Collaborate with other locations and regional leadership to share inventory, labor, and best practices.

Based at the Mandarin Oriental Downtown, Dubai within the Restaurants, Bars & Experiences Department, the RB&E Supervisor is responsible for leading the team during assigned shifts, ensuring exceptional guest service, operational readiness, and smooth day-to-day outlet operations. The role oversees colleague training and development, provides coaching and guidance, completes administrative responsibilities, and contributes to continuous improvements that enhance operational performance and the overall guest experience. title: Netværks- og driftsspecialist til grøn koncern i vækst
description:
CJ Holding med hovedsæde i Give er i rivende udvikling, og vi søger nu en erfaren og selvkørende netværks- og driftsspecialist, som vil være med til at forme fremtidens IT-infrastruktur på tværs af koncernen.

CJ Holding holder til hos datterselskabet Welcon A/S, men dine opgaver vil være fordelt på alle koncernens selskaber, herunder Welcon, Superwood og Gamekeeper.

Om stillingen

Du bliver en del af et stærkt IT-team, hvor du får hovedansvaret for netværk og serverdrift. Sammen med teamets IT-specialist får du en central rolle i at udvikle koncernens IT-infrastruktur, hvor I supplerer hinanden med hver jeres faglige styrker. Vi er godt i gang med at modernisere vores netværk og driftsmiljø, og du får ansvaret for at føre moderniseringen i mål og sikre en stabil drift fremover.

Dine primære opgaver

Netværk og sikkerhed

  • Drift, konfiguration og videreudvikling af koncernens segmenterede netværk (VLAN, routing, switching og wireless), med vægt på 24/7 drift.
  • Administration af firewalls, herunder regelsæt, VPN og overvågning.
  • Drift og videreudvikling af vores NAC-løsning.
  • Fejlfinding på tværs af netværk, firewall og endpoints.

Serverdrift

  • Drift og vedligeholdelse af koncernens Windows Server-, Linux- og SQL Server-miljø.
  • Opfølgning på og koordinering med den eksterne leverandør, der drifter vores Hyper-V cluster, så vi sikrer stabil 24/7-drift af de forretningskritiske systemer.
  • Patch management, backup og overvågning, så vi sikrer høj oppetid og stabil drift.
  • Ansvar for lifecycle management af serverne, så de løbende holdes compliant og ingen kører videre efter udløb af producentens support, herunder planlægning af opgraderinger og udskiftning i god tid.
  • Administration af Active Directory og Entra ID.

Service desk og dokumentation

  • Hjælpe service desk med at analysere og løse de mere komplekse sager, typisk inden for netværk og servere.
  • Udarbejde og vedligeholde teknisk dokumentation, herunder netværksdiagrammer, konfigurationer og driftsprocedurer.
  • Bidrage til, at viden deles i teamet, så vi ikke er afhængige af enkeltpersoner.

Du tilbyder

Du har en relevant uddannelse som datamatiker, datatekniker eller lignende og har minimum 3 års erfaring med netværk og serverdrift. Vi forestiller os, at du har:

  • God erfaring med drift af større, segmenterede netværk, herunder VLAN, routing og switching.
  • Praktisk erfaring med next-generation firewalls og NAC-løsninger fra anerkendte producenter.
  • Flere års praktisk erfaring med selvstændig drift af Windows Server, Linux, SQL Server, Active Directory/Entra ID og virtualisering.

Som person er du struktureret og grundig, og du kan holde overblikket i et miljø med flere igangværende opgaver og projekter. Du trives med frihed under ansvar, tager ejerskab for dine opgaver og følger dem til dørs. Du er hjælpsom og har ikke noget imod at træde til, når service desk har brug for en ekstra hånd.

Vi tilbyder

  • En alsidig stilling med stor indflydelse på koncernens netværk og infrastruktur og mulighed for at præge den videre udvikling og konsolidering.
  • Faglig udvikling gennem nye opgaver, ansvar og sparring med dygtige kolleger, med mulighed for relevant efteruddannelse, når behovet opstår.
  • En flad ledelsesstruktur med kort vej fra idé til handling.
  • En uformel kultur med dygtige kolleger og god plads til humor.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Lars Nielsen, Head of IT, på telefon 20 75 73 88.

Vi ønsker, at du starter hurtigst muligt, og vi holder samtaler løbende, så send gerne din ansøgning og dit CV allerede i dag.

title: Uddannelseskonsulent til Lolland-Falsters Stift
description:
Lolland-Falsters Stift søger en uddannelseskonsulent for en fireårig periode.

Der er tale om en stilling på 25 %, som enten kan besættes ved frikøb af en allerede ansat præst i stiftet eller som en selvstændig 25 %-stilling. Stillingen er midlertidig i 4 år, med mulighed for forlængelse.

Det er en forudsætning for ansættelsen, at du er ordineret præst og har afsluttet den obligatoriske efteruddannelse.

Uddannelseskonsulenten har til opgave:

  • at være tovholder på og have overblik over den enkelte nye præsts efteruddannelsesforløb, herunder at tilrettelægge en introduktionsplan i samarbejde med FUV

  • at medvirke til introduktionssamtaler, afrundingssamtaler og evt. andre samtaler mellem provst og nyansat præst

  • at være tovholder for stiftets vejlederpræster (mentorer)

  • at være tovholder for den lokale religionspædagogiske, homiletiske og liturgiske sparring i introduktionsordningen, evt. sammen med andre aktører

  • at følge op lokalt på arbejdsvejledning for nye præster i form af besøg på arbejdsstedet

  • at medvirke til overdragelse af introduktionsplanen til anden uddannelseskonsulent i tilfælde af embedsskift

  • at deltage i 2-3 årlige møder med FUV og gruppen af uddannelseskonsulenter

  • deltagelse i planlægningen af præstepraktikken

  • afholde kurser for nye præster

  • at være løbende orienteret om FUVs uddannelsestilbud

Det vil være en fordel, hvis du har solid præsteerfaring og har viden om og erfaring med den folkekirkelige organisation.

Du vil indgå i et netværk og samarbejde med de andre stifters uddannelseskonsulenter.

Såfremt du ikke har erfaring som uddannelseskonsulent, vil du blive klædt på til opgaven i et samarbejde med FUV og de øvrige uddannelseskonsulenter.

Ansættelse pr. 1. januar i fire år med mulighed for forlængelse. Stillingen er indplaceret i løngruppe 3, sats 1.

Hvis du er ansat i en stilling som overenskomstansat sognepræst, eller ansættes som uddannelseskonsulent i henhold til gældende overenskomst for akademikere i staten med tilhørende protokollat, vil du blive indplaceret, så din løn for stillingen som uddannelseskonsulent svarer til løngruppe 3, sats 1.

Eventuelle spørgsmål til stillingen kan rettes til biskop Marianne Gaarden tlf. 2910 0119 eller stiftskontorchef Lene M. Krabbesmark på tlf. 2025 8088.

Ansøgningen sendes til Lolland-Falsters Stift på lfstift@km.dk og skal være stiftet i hænde den 23. november 2026 kl. 15.00. Ansættelsessamtaler afholdes den 3. december 2026.

title: Duty Manager - The Capitol Hotel
description:
About EVT: The Capitol Hotel is part of EVT, one of Australasia’s market-leading experience creators offering careers that can take you wherever you want to go across entertainment, ventures, and travel. In a world of cookie cutter experiences, here at EVT we believe in changing the game. It’s why we all call ourselves Daymakers - because each day is a chance to add the wow factor for our customers and continually grow in our own careers.

The Independent Collection is a curated selection of hotels, each of which lives up to an exacting standard to offer travellers the best of luxury, elevated, urban, comfort and social experiences. While every hotel celebrates its own unique brand & experience, together the Independent Collection shares a passion for one-of-a-kind experiences, service and quality.

EVT has an endless range of roles and careers paths to explore across over 140 entertainment experiences like Event Cinemas and Moonlight Cinemas, 150 award winning restaurants and bars, and 80+ hotels, including QT, Rydges, Atura, LyLo, Independent Collection and Australia’s most loved year round alpine resort, Thredbo. Our ventures include a ~$2.3B property portfolio and hotel management, just to name a few. Once you’re in, there’s no limits on where your career could take you.

Key Responsibilities

As a Duty Manager you will:

Lead and oversee hotel operations during shifts and assist any department when required, ensuring smooth coordination in the absence of senior management.
Support and supervise Front Office operations, ensuring staff presentation, punctuality, and service standards are consistently met.
Maintain a high level of guest satisfaction by proactively resolving issues, managing complaints, and promoting a welcoming service culture.
Monitor hotel security and safety procedures, ensuring compliance with WH&S standards and effective incident management.
Drive occupancy and revenue by supporting rate management strategies and collaborating with key departments to maximise sales opportunities.
Ensure effective communication across departments to support operational efficiency and guest experience.
Assist with rostering, staffing levels, and cost control to meet financial targets and maintain service quality.
Effectively manage staff including training, rostering and monitoring of overtime, annual leave, days in lieu, staff breaks and other staff entitlements.

What You’ll Bring

1+ years of experience a duty manager role or similar within a branded or independent hotel.
The ability to lead hotel operations in the absence of senior management, ensuring smooth and professional service delivery.
Strong understanding of Front Office operations, including rostering, guest arrivals/departures, and team coordination.
Demonstrated experience in managing hotel security, guest complaints, and incident reporting with a solution-focused approach.
Skilled in driving occupancy and revenue through effective rate management and collaboration with key departments.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, fostering positive relationships across departments and with guests.
Ability to promote hotel features and services, cultivating a strong sales culture and enhancing guest experience.

How You Work

Daymaker ethos — no one’s too big for the small things.
Inclusive leader — values diverse perspectives; builds belonging.
Owner’s mindset — acts on data/feedback; ships improvements.
Hands-on and non-hierarchical — leads from the front.

Perks from Day One
As part of EVT, you unlock Elevate Perks from your first day. Parity for all levels - no ivory towers.

50% off dining and stays across EVT hotels – QT, Rydges, Atura, LyLo and more.
$2 movie tickets + discounts on Gold Class, Moonlight Cinema and Candy Bar.
Seasonal perks at Thredbo.
Rapid career growth across our hotel & entertainment network.
Paid parental leave; community & volunteering opportunities.

Apply Now
Join The Captiol Hotel and become an EVT experience creator, opportunity taker, the ultimate Daymaker. Join and make a positive impact on our people, communities, and environment every day.

Send your CV and a short cover letter. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and review applications as they come in - don’t wait! We can’t wait to see the places your career will go with EVT.

When you click apply, you’ll be taken to our secure EVT careers portal (powered by Dayforce). This is our official system for managing applications across the EVT Group. You’ll simply enter your details and answer a few quick screening questions so we can get to know you better.

Police Check Acknowledgement
Please note that the successful candidate for this position will be required to undergo and satisfactorily pass a criminal record check as part of the recruitment process.

title: Commercial Lines Product Manager
description:
THREE is changing the way businesses think about commercial insurance. We bring essential business insurance coverages together into a simpler, more straightforward experience for agents and their clients. By combining Liability, Property, Cyber, Auto, and Workers Comp, we offer coverage for the whole business in a single policy.


We're looking for a commercially minded, analytically strong Commercial Lines Product Manager to own the performance and evolution of your assigned THREE business segment. This role will drive product strategy, portfolio profitability, and scalable growth while partnering across the organization to continuously improve our products and customer experience.


The Role


You will be responsible for the P&L and product performance of your assigned THREE business segment(s) and/or regions/territories, using data, market insights, and underwriting results to drive profitable growth. We want someone who combines commercial P&C insurance expertise with strong analytical skills, sound business judgment, and a bias toward execution. You will also partner with peer Product Managers on countrywide product initiatives and broader company priorities.


Job Responsibilities


  • Own the assigned financial performance, including premium growth, loss ratio, expense trends, retention, and overall profitability.
  • Develop and execute product strategies that support profitable growth, competitive positioning, and a consistent agent and customer experience.
  • Monitor portfolio results and key performance indicators, identify performance trends, and recommend actions to improve underwriting results and business outcomes.
  • Partner with Underwriting, Actuarial, Claims, Finance, and Sales to evaluate results, refine pricing and underwriting strategies, and address emerging performance issues.
  • Lead product enhancements and countrywide initiatives, including coverage development, rating changes, underwriting guidelines, and process improvements.
  • Evaluate market trends, competitor offerings, agent feedback, and customer needs to identify opportunities for product improvement and growth.
  • Collaborate with Product team on shared product capabilities, countrywide initiatives, and consistent execution across THREE.
  • Work with Engineering, Product & Operations, and other stakeholders to prioritize and implement product changes that improve efficiency, scalability, and the agent and customer experience.

title: FPGA Design Engineer- Cisco Silicon One
description:
Meet the Team

The Silicon One team creates innovative hardware platforms central to the AI era, powering Cisco’s core Switching, Routing, and Wireless products for organizations globally. Our innovations in silicon, optics, and hardware platforms are shaping the technology industry. We're a global team of creative experts, bringing our unique backgrounds and bold ideas to push boundaries and help each other grow. Because full product development—from design to qualification to production—is within our team, we’re able to think differently, experiment more, and work quickly. Join us to power the future of the digital world!.

Your Impact

Lead the FPGA design and development of complex systems supporting next-generation networking devices and AI infrastructure, from initial architecture through implementation, validation, and production. You will take technical ownership of FPGA design activities, including architecture definition, RTL development, simulation, synthesis, timing closure, and hardware validation.

  • Define FPGA specifications, develop and implement RTL designs, and collaborate with Hardware, ASIC, Software, and System engineering teams throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Design and integrate high-speed interfaces and communication protocols, including PCIe, Ethernet, and SerDes. Conduct FPGA bring-up, characterization, debugging, and validation in a lab environment.
  • Identify and resolve complex functional, timing, and integration issues through simulation, debugging tools, and hardware measurements.

Minimum Qualifications

  • B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering or equivalent practical experience.
  • 4+ years of experience as an FPGA design engineer, developing and delivering complex FPGA-based projects.
  • Experience in RTL design using Verilog or SystemVerilog.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with FPGA architecture, design implementation, synthesis, place-and-route, and timing closure.
  • Solid understanding of digital design principles, including clock domain crossing (CDC), timing constraints, synchronization, and reset methodologies.
  • Experience with FPGA simulation, functional verification, and debugging using industry-standard EDA tools.
  • Experience integrating FPGA IP cores, memory interfaces, and communication protocols.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Kort beskrivelse

Support a 9-year-old boy in Skævinge

Jobbeskrivelse

Do you have experience working with children with special needs, and do you enjoy an active one-to-one role? Then you could become an important source of support for a 9-year-old boy who loves movement, play and safe, predictable routines.

About the role

You will provide regular one-to-one support for a 9-year-old boy with autism and an intellectual disability. He needs close support, clear structure and a calm approach that helps create predictability.

The boy is energetic, enjoys being active and particularly likes outdoor play, trips to the playground and running in the woods. He also enjoys activities such as puzzles, music, bubbles, balloons and sensory toys. Your role is to plan and take part in activities that match his pace and needs. As he has limited awareness of danger, it is important that you stay close to him and remain attentive to his surroundings.

The role includes assistance with personal care, including bathing, changing diapers and toilet training. You will also provide support at mealtimes, with a focus on motivating and guiding him towards gradually becoming more independent.

The boy does not communicate verbally and uses only a few English words. It is therefore important that you are able to communicate in English, including with his parents, who do not speak Danish.

The boy has food allergies and has an EpiPen, which must be used in the event of an allergic reaction. The family will provide thorough instructions on its use. He also has asthma, and his parents are responsible for all medication management.

About you

You may be a qualified pedagogue/social educator or have relevant experience working with children with special needs. You approach the child with calmness, patience and clarity, and you enjoy an active working environment where you take part in play and physical activities.

At the same time, you are able to create structure and a sense of security, be attentive and provide clear boundaries when needed. As communication with the family takes place in English, you must be able to communicate confidently in English.

A driving licence is an advantage. Alternatively, you must be comfortable using the family’s cargo bike, which will be provided.

Working hours

The position is for 16 hours per week. The working hours are:

Two weekdays per week: 3 hours after school, from 2:30 pm to 5:30 pm

Thursdays: 9:30 am to 1:30 pm (4 hours)

Sundays: 11:00 am to 5:00 pm

What we offer

You will become part of a family-owned company with many dedicated employees. You will have a dedicated adviser who is available for guidance and support. Outside office hours, a staffed emergency phone line is always available, so you are never on your own.

Salary and pension are provided in accordance with the national collective agreement between FOA and the Danish Chamber of Commerce (Dansk Erhverv). You are covered by DUOS’ liability and occupational injury insurance, and health insurance is included as part of your pension scheme.

We offer a wide range of courses, and as a DUOS employee, you will receive relevant induction and ongoing professional development. Working with people at DUOS also gives you the opportunity to develop both personally and professionally.

Would you like to become our new colleague?

Please submit your application via the link. You must have a profile on mit.duos.dk and be logged in to apply. We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible. The position is available for an immediate start.

If you have any further questions, please contact Recruitment Consultant Trine Ankær Johansen on +45 36 34 49 90. You can also find answers to general questions in our FAQ.

We are people helping people

At DUOS, we help people in their everyday lives, support them through challenging situations and contribute to their well-being and quality of life. As one of Denmark’s largest and longest-established welfare service providers, we strive to be there where support is needed.

We understand the importance of combining empathy with the right professional expertise, and we know that finding the right match between an employee and the person receiving support is essential for our services to make a meaningful difference.

Join the DUOS team and make an important difference in another person’s life.

title: AI Product Engineer
description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

ABOUT THE ROLE

JLL's Project & Development Services business line is building production AI capabilities for construction and real estate project delivery, and we need someone who thinks at a systems level. You're a solution developer, but you’re also an engineer who builds the infrastructure that makes AI solutions reliable, scalable, and maintainable.

In this role you'll be responsible for the engineering layer underneath our AI-powered workflow tools: the extraction scripts, validation frameworks, output schemas, integration connectors, and quality harnesses that turn a capable AI model into a dependable production tool. You'll set engineering standards, make architectural decisions, and be the person others come to when a pipeline is misbehaving in a way nobody can explain.


WHAT THIS JOB INVOLVES

Working With Real-World Data Enterprise AI solutions are only as good as the data they operate on, and real-world business data is rarely clean, consistent, or structured the way a model would prefer. You'll develop deep familiarity with the information landscape of construction and real estate project delivery, understanding what data exists, where it lives, what form it takes, and what has to happen before an AI model can do something useful with it.

Output Design and Quality Assurance You'll design the structured output contracts that govern what AI solutions produce and build the validation logic that enforces them. When a solution produces unexpected output or degrades silently on an unusual document, you'll own the detection and recovery logic. You'll define what production-ready looks like before building begins, run solutions against diverse real-world document sets, and maintain quality as the underlying models and input corpus evolve over time.

Enterprise System Integration You'll connect AI solutions to JLL's enterprise environment using REST APIs, Microsoft Graph, SharePoint, OneDrive, and other standard integration surfaces. You'll handle authentication lifecycle, retry logic, rate limits, and the realities of operating inside an enterprise network with real access controls. You'll design integrations that are resilient and maintainable, not just functional in a demo environment.

Agentic Architecture and MCP Integration As AI solutions grow more capable, you'll design and build multi-step reasoning pipelines that connect models to enterprise tools and data through the Model Context Protocol and similar agentic infrastructure. You'll think carefully about how to structure tool availability, manage context across steps, and build agent workflows that are reliable and auditable rather than unpredictable. You'll stay current on how this space is evolving and bring informed opinions about when agentic patterns are the right approach and when they aren't.

Platform Engineering and Standards As the AI solution portfolio grows, you'll establish and maintain the engineering patterns others follow: packaging conventions, versioning, configuration management, logging, and error handling. You'll write internal tooling that makes building new solutions faster and less error-prone, and you'll make architectural decisions that hold up as the team and codebase scale.


DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS

Candidates who bring most of the following will be strongly considered. This is a genuinely new field though. The expectation isn't that you arrive knowing everything on this list; it's that you're the kind of person who would be pursuing most of it on your own regardless.


Engineering Foundation

  • Strong Python proficiency: data parsing, file I/O, schema validation, subprocess management, packaging, and test authoring (pytest or similar)
  • Solid understanding of REST API design and consumption, including auth patterns (OAuth, API keys, token refresh), pagination, and error handling
  • Comfort with document parsing libraries: PyMuPDF, python-docx, openpyxl, pandas, and equivalent tools for common enterprise file formats
  • Experience with Git-based development workflows: branching, versioning, code review, and structured release management
  • Familiarity with enterprise integration surfaces, particularly Microsoft 365 (SharePoint, OneDrive, Graph API)

AI Engineering

  • Hands-on experience building the code layer around LLM APIs: structuring prompts programmatically, managing token budgets, parsing and validating model outputs, and handling failure cases gracefully
  • Understanding of how structured context, schema-constrained outputs, and validation pipelines improve AI solution reliability in production
  • Familiarity with document chunking, embedding workflows, and retrieval patterns (RAG), including the tradeoffs between retrieval approaches for enterprise document types
  • Exposure to agentic patterns, multi-step reasoning pipelines, and tool use via MCP or similar protocols

Quality and Reliability

  • Experience building test infrastructure for systems with probabilistic outputs: evaluation frameworks, regression suites, benchmark datasets
  • Comfort defining "correct" programmatically for outputs that don't have a single right answer, and building scoring logic that reflects domain standards
  • Instinct for failure modes: silent errors, schema drift, edge-case documents, and model-version-induced regressions

Domain Familiarity

  • Experience in or meaningful exposure to construction, commercial real estate, or professional services environments is a plus
  • Prior work in a technical role at a professional services firm, PropTech company, or enterprise software organization is relevant background

Mindset

  • You’ve built something from scratch specifically to understand how it worked
  • You're comfortable making principled decisions in the absence of established conventions, and you document those decisions so the next person understands the reasoning
  • You hold your technical opinions firmly enough to be useful and loosely enough to update them
  • You're energized by fields where the tooling is still being invented and you can influence how it develops

title: IT Support & Implementation Manager - ( Job ID - 24615)
description:
We are seeking an empathetic, articulate, and proactive IT Support & Implementation Manager based at our Surat office. This role serves as the vital bridge between our product/technical teams and our end users and clients.

You do not need to be a software developer or deep technologist—our ideal candidate thrives on listening to user pain points, translating business needs into straightforward requirements, facilitating smooth tech rollouts, and making sure clients feel completely supported throughout product delivery.

  • Track product delivery milestones from initial sign-off to live implementation.

  • Act as the point of contact between client stakeholders and internal development/engineering teams.

  • Ensure user feedback is documented, prioritized, and fed back into product roadmaps.

  • Communication Excellence: Fluency in English and Hindi (proficiency in Gujarati is a strong plus for local stakeholder coordination).

  • Interpersonal Skills: Natural ability to build rapport, de-escalate frustration, and resolve issues collaboratively.

  • Client Handling: Prior experience in client-facing roles, client success, account coordination, or tech implementation.

  • Basic Tech Literacy: Comfort working with web applications, productivity suites (Google Workspace, MS Office, Slack), and ticketing tools; deep technical/coding skills are not required.

  • Problem-Solving Mindset: Resourceful, organized, and dedicated to seeing problems through to completion.


What We Offer

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

  • Collaborative and supportive work environment.

  • Opportunities for growth in client relationship management, implementation consulting, and product operations.

title: Customer Proposition Director
description:

Te Whiwhinga mahi | The opportunity

We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced senior customer, product or service leader to join our Service Modernisation function as Customer Proposition Director.


This is a significant enterprise leadership role responsible for setting and stewarding the strategic direction for NZTA’s customer propositions and future-state customer experience across our customer-facing products and services. You will define what we should offer our customers, the value those propositions should create and the outcomes they need to deliver.


Working across the organisation, you will shape the Service Modernisation roadmap, bringing together customer strategy, proposition and product direction, service design, digital channels and operational delivery. You will help prioritise and sequence initiatives to create simpler customer journeys, increase digital uptake, improve compliance outcomes, reduce the cost to serve and deliver better service performance.


You will operate at an enterprise level, influencing across Digital, Regulatory Services, Transport Services, System Leadership and operational teams. You will navigate complex dependencies and competing priorities, broker strategic trade-offs and provide clear advice to senior leaders and governance forums on the choices and investment required to deliver a modern, efficient and customer-centred organisation.


The role also has significant influence over investment choices across the Service Modernisation roadmap.


Click here to view the position description.


Ko koe tēnei | About you

To be successful in this role, you will bring significant senior leadership experience across areas such as customer proposition, product management, customer experience, service design, digital transformation, service modernisation or complex service delivery.


You will also bring:

  • Proven experience defining future-state customer experiences and translating strategy into practical roadmaps, priorities and investment choices
  • Strong understanding of digital-first and omnichannel service delivery and end-to-end customer journeys
  • Strong strategic and systems thinking, with the judgement to navigate ambiguity and make complex trade-offs
  • Proven ability to use customer insight, data and performance information to shape strategic decisions
  • Highly developed influencing and relationship management skills, with credibility at executive and senior leadership level
  • Experience developing robust business cases and influencing significant investment decisions
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to provide clear, persuasive advice to senior decision makers and governance forums

This is an opportunity to have a significant influence on how customers interact with NZTA now and into the future, helping create services that are increasingly simple, joined-up, digitally enabled and centred around customer needs.


Ko wai mātou | About us

The Customer and Services group delivers transactional products and services that support the effective operation of New Zealand's land transport system. We work to make services simple, easy to use and effective, while continually improving the experience of people interacting with NZTA.


The Service Modernisation function leads an agency-wide programme of continuous modernisation and improvement, championing a customer-centric, digitally enabled future. title: Lead Game Programmer
description:
Do you love designing clean game architecture, building multiplayer systems that run smoothly, and helping a team of programmers make the right technical decisions? Great! Let’s talk.

Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by a simple mission: to make everyone laugh.

We're building something unannounced, exciting, thoroughly goofy, and built to be played together online. We're now looking for a Lead Game Programmer to help building the underlying systems that make it all work, from the core architecture to the multiplayer tech that connects our players. You'll stay hands-on in the code and the Unity editor while helping the programming team make good technical decisions, stay aligned, and build systems that support creative experimentation. And just to be very clear: this is a technical leadership role, not a people-management position.

**Here’s What That Looks Like Day To Day

**

  • In collaboration with game designers, artists, and other programmers, you’ll build new features and systems and continuously iterate on improvements. We all work in Unity with C#, with every team member hands-on in the editor
  • You’ll set and communicate the project’s technical direction, turning creative goals and production needs into clear technical priorities
  • You’ll help the programming team make architectural decisions, align around shared patterns, and navigate trade-offs between long-term code health and short-term needs
  • You’ll review and improve technical solutions, share best practices, and support other programmers without becoming a gatekeeper or bottleneck
  • You’ll proactively identify technical risks, messy systems, and missing foundations, and take responsibility for addressing them at the right time
  • Overall, you’ll make sure the project is technically healthy and maintain the codebase in a way that makes it easy for others to build on

**This includes things like...

**

  • Designing an architecture that allows for easy gameplay implementation and flexibility
  • Implementing and maintaining online features such as matchmaking, invites and friends
  • Profiling and improving network performance, bandwidth and latency, and making sure the game holds up on real-world connections
  • Breaking down complex technical challenges, helping decide what to prioritise, and ensuring important decisions are understood by the people they affect
  • Staying close to the actual game: writing production code, debugging difficult problems, and improving systems as the project evolves

**You’re a great match if

**

  • You have at least ten years of professional game development experience across multiple shipped games and different stages of development, including significant technical ownership or leadership on a project
  • You have experience setting technical direction and helping a programming team make and implement architectural decisions, with strong judgment in balancing flexibility, maintainability, performance and the needs of a creative production
  • You're highly proficient in C# and have deep knowledge of the Unity engine and editor
  • You've shipped at least one online multiplayer game, had real ownership of its networking/online systems, and have hands-on experience with a Unity multiplayer framework (e.g., Coherence)
  • You communicate clearly and can explain technical decisions and trade-offs to programmers and non-programmers alike

**Nice to haves

**

  • You have experience shipping iOS and macOS apps, including hands-on integration of Apple platform services such as GameKit and the Game Controller framework using Xcode and Swift
  • Experience with backend services, dedicated servers or cloud hosting for online games
  • Interest in multiplayer game design and social features
  • Experience working with automated build pipelines such as Jenkins
  • Experience building systemic or open-world games

**What Always Matters To Us At Triband

**

  • You thrive in taking ownership of your area: you spot problems, seek advice when needed, and implement creative solutions that push projects forward
  • You’re motivated by collaboration, mutual respect, inclusiveness and creativity while actively contributing to sustaining that culture
  • You believe games are made by teams, not rockstars and that great ideas can come from anyone
  • You bring curiosity, generosity, and flexibility, along with strong opinions, especially when they come with reasoning, openness, and a willingness to actually test them
  • You love exploration and experimentation but don’t get too precious when the evidence tells you you’re wrong
  • You value a positive work environment and contribute to keeping the studio a fun and supportive place to be

**Practicalities

**

  • We work on-site at our cozy office in central Copenhagen.
  • For this role we also consider people located outside of Denmark and provide financial (and moral!) support with visa application and relocation.
  • We work a 37-hour work week, with core hours 10-15, and the freedom to start and finish anywhere between 7 and 18.
  • Our working language is English.

**We offer

**

  • Silly but ambitious projects, and the chance to work on and impact great games that reach millions of players.
  • A playful and ambitious work environment where experimentation is encouraged.
  • Friendly and kind colleagues who love making each other laugh as much as making games.
  • A professional development budget to invest in your growth.
  • Social activities like Friday bars, hobby nights, board game nights, team events, you name it.
  • Daily lunch at a local restaurant just a walk across the lakes away, with plant-based options (and soft ice on Thursdays).
  • Six weeks of vacation (five standard plus one extra on us).
  • Paid parental leave at full salary for the periods covered by state reimbursement.
  • Child's first sick day on us, no questions asked.
  • Pension plan and private health insurance.
  • Endless amounts of Faxe Kondi.

**WHAT THE TRIBAND?

**Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, which is played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by our mission to make everyone laugh. To do so, we focus on exploring comedy through gameplay. We like to break player expectations, use wonderful music, slick art, and create a quirky atmosphere. We experiment a lot, and it doesn't always work out, but we always learn something.

We put people first and strive to create a safe and creative working environment. We believe that teams, not individuals, make games, and we believe diversity makes for better teams. For these reasons, we look for people who bring new perspectives and will challenge us and our way of doing things.

For more info about Triband, check out: triband.net/about

title: Senior Product Owner (ePI)
description:
About the Team:

Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise.

Enterprise Systems Management & Business Operations delivers digital solutions that support Enterprise Systems running as a high-performing organisation. This team drives financial discipline, operational rigour and strategic alignment across the ES portfolio that safeguard GSK’s integrity and reputation globally. By joining this team, you’ll help shape systems that support thousands of employees worldwide, driving innovation and reliability in the tools that keep GSK moving forward.

Job Purpose:

· The Senior Product Owner (ePI) is responsible for maximising the value of Electronic Product Information by translating regulatory and operational business needs into a prioritised backlog and leading delivery across a complex product ecosystem. The role ensures that regulatory- and process-driven changes are delivered within applicable GxP, compliance, data-use and data-access requirements and within strategic and financial guardrails agreed with the Product Manager in line with Tech leadership direction. Working closely with business stakeholders and external partners, the Product Owner defines outcomes and ensures delivered functionality is usable, secure, compliant, supportable and aligned to product strategy.

· The Senior Product Owner (ePI) guides Product Analysts and works with Engineers, Architects, Testers, Service teams and external partners to ensure requirements are clear, value-driven and data-informed. The job holder makes day-to-day backlog and acceptance decisions, oversees iterative delivery and uses product performance information to improve adoption, stability, user experience and operational readiness.

· The role is accountable for maintaining clarity of scope and decision making throughout discovery, refinement, design, testing, release and operation. Strategic investment, major architecture and cross-product trade-offs that exceed delegated authority are escalated to the Product Manager, who coordinates further escalation to the Product Domain Lead or Tech leadership team in line with agreed decision rights.

Key Responsibilities:

· Partner with business stakeholders to understand functional needs, refine requirements and define product outcomes and maintain alignment throughout delivery.

· Lead end-to-end product delivery across the complex ePI ecosystem, guiding Product Analysts and coordinating Engineers, Architects, Testers, enterprise platform teams and external partners to ensure solutions are fit for purpose, secure, compliant, supportable and aligned to applicable standards.

· Ensure ePI product changes, including regulatory-driven changes, comply with applicable GxP, security, data-use, data-access, privacy, quality, validation, change and regulatory controls, obtaining specialist approvals where required.

· Own and manage the product backlog, ensuring epics, features and user stories are well defined and supported by relevant data on value, users, cost, risk, dependencies and process impact.

· Use AI tools to draft requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria and summaries of stakeholder input, and have the output reviewed before it enters the backlog.

· Make backlog prioritisation decisions based on value, cost, risk, business continuity and resource capacity, escalating strategic trade-offs in line with the agreed RACI.

· Lead refinement, demonstrations, acceptance and release decisions and maintain clear traceability from business outcome through requirement, test and delivered change.

· Drive operational readiness using a structured checklist covering support model, training, continuity, configuration, runbooks, release notes, validation evidence and user onboarding.

· Define and maintain the product performance dashboard, tracking adoption, process outcomes, cycle time, stability, defects, user experience and support effort.

· Support Architects in assessing design options and manage cross-product dependencies, interface impacts and release sequencing.

· Build working knowledge of the ePI platforms and, with guidance, identify straightforward improvement opportunities, such as regulatory-change automation, and flag them to the Product Manager for assessment.

· Act as an escalation point for the product team and business users on functional product issues and guide resolution within agreed guardrails.

· Coordinate supplier delivery and hold external partners accountable for quality, documentation, knowledge transfer and product outcomes.

· Promote agile, iterative, value-driven and data-led delivery and use feedback and performance insights to continuously improve the product.

Basic Requirements:

Education & Professional Qualifications:

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Life Sciences or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

Area of Specialisation

· Product ownership and product lifecycle management

· Requirements, backlog and acceptance management

· Agile and iterative delivery

· User-centred design and adoption

· Product performance, operational readiness and continuous improvement

· Enterprise technology, data, integration, security and service principles

· Understanding of regulated manufacturing, supply chain, quality or laboratory environments

· The role requires sufficient technical, analytical and business understanding to translate operational needs into controlled product changes. The education or equivalent experience enables the job holder to evaluate value, feasibility, process impact, data, risk, security, compliance and support implications and to communicate clearly with business and technology specialists.

Job-Related Experience:

· Minimum Level of Job-Related Experience Required

· Typically 5+ years of experience in product ownership, business analysis, digital solutions, technology delivery or process-led technology roles.

· Proven experience defining and prioritising epics, features, user stories and acceptance criteria and managing a product backlog.

· Exposure to AI tooling used for discovery, refinement or drafting, with human review of outputs before they enter the backlog.

· Experience managing digital products within a complex ecosystem of business functions, regulatory stakeholders, enterprise platforms and external partners, ideally involving Electronic Product Information or comparable regulatory-driven solutions.

· Experience working directly with business stakeholders to translate needs into feasible, value-led technology changes.

· Demonstrated ability to prioritise based on value, process impact, risk, cost, capacity and technology dependencies.

· Experience guiding Product Analysts, Engineers, Architects and Testers through refinement, design, testing, release and adoption.

· Experience applying GxP, security, data protection, data-use and data-access restrictions, quality, validation, change and service-readiness controls in a regulated environment.

· Experience defining product performance measures and using user, process, stability and service insights to improve outcomes.

· Experience working in agile or iterative delivery environments and coordinating suppliers or external delivery partners.

Preferred:

· Product ownership, agile delivery, business analysis, change, process improvement or service management certifications are desirable.

title: Senior DFT Engineer - Cisco Silicon One
description:
Cisco Silicon One is looking for a Senior DFT Engineer to join our team in Israel.


Meet the Team

The Silicon One team creates innovative hardware platforms central to the AI era, powering Cisco’s core Switching, Routing, and Wireless products for organizations globally. Our innovations in silicon, optics, and hardware platforms are shaping the technology industry. We're a global team of creative experts, bringing our unique backgrounds and bold ideas to push boundaries and help each other grow. Because full product development—from design to qualification to production—is within our team, we’re able to think differently, experiment more, and work quickly. Join us to power the future of the digital world


Your Impact

As an Experienced DFT Engineer, you will:

  • Develop and implement DFT features to ensure high-quality, testable, and manufacturable designs.
  • Contribute to the full product cycle, from pre-silicon design to post-silicon debug and production qualification.
  • Collaborate across multiple hardware teams throughout the silicon lifecycle.
  • Implement ATPG, scan compression, and memory BIST techniques to improve test coverage and efficiency.
  • Lead debugging and root-cause analysis of silicon failures to improve yield and reliability.
  • Establish DFT methodologies and best practices to improve the efficiency of future designs.

Minimum Qualifications

  • B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering or a related field.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with one or more DFT domains, such as scan insertion, BIST, or boundary scan, silicon debug.
  • Experience with Automatic Test Pattern Generation (ATPG) methodologies.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong ability to establish and refine DFT methodologies from design phase to high-volume production.
  • Ability to quickly learn new concepts and adapt to evolving technologies.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and system-level understanding of networking and silicon solutions.

description:
**Enhance the Security of Future Endoscopy Solutions

**Are you passionate about cybersecurity and interested in protecting innovative medical technologies that help clinicians improve patient care?

We are looking for a Product Security Engineer to help build cybersecurity into the next generation of endoscopy systems and connected healthcare solutions.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing cybersecurity function and contribute directly to the security of products used by healthcare professionals worldwide.

In this role you will work closely with software, electronics, systems, quality, regulatory, and product development teams to ensure cybersecurity is integrated throughout the product lifecycle. You will have the opportunity to influence technical decisions, improve security practices, and make a tangible impact on both product security and patient safety.

We believe the best ideas come from a mix of in-person collaboration and focused individual work. That's why this role is based in Augsburg or Ballerup and follows a hybrid working model, with three days per week in the office and two days working from home.

**Key Responsibilities

**As a Product Security Engineer, you will drive cybersecurity activities throughout the development and maintenance of advanced endoscopic visualization platforms.

**Your Main Responsibilities Will Include

**

  • Drive cybersecurity risk management activities for medical devices throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Lead and facilitate threat modelling workshops, security assessments, and architecture reviews.
  • Define, document, and maintain cybersecurity requirements for product development projects.
  • Own vulnerability monitoring, assessment, prioritization, and remediation coordination across development teams.
  • Manage Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) generation, analysis, maintenance, and governance activities.
  • Investigate and drive resolution of cybersecurity issues identified during development, verification, and post-market surveillance.
  • Contribute to and help ensure compliance with applicable medical device cybersecurity regulations, standards, and industry best practices.
  • Collaborate closely with software, systems, electronics, quality, and regulatory teams to integrate security into product development activities.
  • Drive continuous improvement of Product Security processes, templates, guidance, and tools.
  • Act as a cybersecurity subject matter expert for development projects and support teams in making risk-informed security decisions.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen product security posture and proactively initiate improvement activities.

**Suggested candidate profile

****Skills

**Skills and experience can be gained in many ways, and we know the perfect profile cannot be prescribed on paper. You are, however, likely to succeed in this role if you bring many of the following:

  • An educational background within Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Strong interest in product cybersecurity and secure product development.
  • Experience working in a regulated industry is a great advantage; but medical device experience is not required.
  • Hands-on experience with design control, requirements management, risk management, and traceability.
  • Knowledge of compliance with global cybersecurity regulations and standards.
  • Good understanding of networking fundamentals, operating systems (Linux), secure software development practices, and fundamental cybersecurity concepts.
  • Experience with system integration and complex hardware/software/software interactions.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to balance technical depth with product-level decision-making.
  • The ability to work independently, structure complex work, and proactively drive progress across many stakeholders.
  • Comfortable navigating complex technical challenges and coordinating across multiple stakeholders.
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills in a global, cross-functional environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, take ownership of deliverables, and drive activities to completion.

**This is more than a product security role

**You will help secure technologies that clinicians rely on every day to visualize, diagnose, and treat patients. Working within the Product Security Team, you will contribute to the development of products where cybersecurity directly supports patient safety, product reliability, and regulatory compliance. You will join a collaborative environment that values learning, innovation, and continuous improvement while helping establish cybersecurity as a key capability across the organization.

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.
