title: Technical Program Manager, Software
description:
About Ironsite


Ironsite is building the intelligence layer for the physical world. We design our own wearable hardware, deploy it alongside craft workers, and transform a shift's footage into a next-morning report. Our internal team and purpose-built models label the data overnight and deliver actionable insights to superintendents by 5 AM.

We are accelerating the speed, efficiency, and predictability of construction, especially for complex, mission-critical infrastructure projects, including data centers, LNG facilities, sports stadiums, hospitals, and other large-scale developments, by training AI models on egocentric construction footage and labor productivity data. We are built with a pro-worker philosophy at our core: we believe technology should empower the workforce, not replace it. We're working to give craft workers and project leaders better visibility into what's happening on-site, while creating a system where the reality of construction and the chaos of each day are finally available to the people running the project.

Ironsite is deployed across several of the largest active construction projects in the country. To date, we've captured more than 100,000 hours of construction footage across seven states, now process thousands of hours of site activity every day, and maintain a worker opt-out rate below two percent. This is enabled by a workforce-first architecture that anonymizes devices, captures no audio, and never releases raw video.

Ironsite is backed by leading investors (8VC, South Park Commons, Saga Ventures) and prominent operators across technology and construction, including Eric Schmidt, Jeff Dean, Jeff Rothschild, Mark Leslie, Scott Wu, Eric Glyman, Karim Atiyeh, Russell Kaplan, and others, alongside over a dozen construction industry operators who have joined us as partners in building this.

Longer term, we believe Ironsite is the foundation for what construction becomes in the next decade. The systems we're building will be the operating system for how the physical world gets built. We see a future where craft workers are more valued, more visible, and better paid for the skill they bring, and where the industry finally has the intelligence layer that makes autonomous construction possible. Both start with the same foundation.

The Role


We're hiring our first Technical Program Manager to build how Ironsite plans and ships, and to grow that into a program management team as we scale.

Today we have no formal planning process. Hardware, infrastructure, ML, research, platform, field apps, and customer deployments all move fast, and they all land on the same nightly critical path: footage captured in the afternoon becomes a report superintendents trust by 5 AM. Priorities get set in hallway conversations, dependencies surface late, and commitments to customers depend on heroics.

You'll change that. You'll set up the planning cadence, roadmaps, and tracking that every team runs on, own the programs that cross team lines, and make sure what we promise customers is what we deliver.

What You'll Own


  • Planning & Operating Cadence. Build the system Ironsite runs on: quarterly planning, team roadmaps, a single source of truth for priorities and status, and the weekly and monthly reviews that keep leadership and teams aligned. You'll decide how much process we need, introduce it, and make it stick.
  • Cross-Team Launches. Own the programs that span hardware, platform, ML, and field apps, from new product surfaces to model and device rollouts. You'll define scope, owners, milestones, and risks, and drive them to done.
  • Customer Deployments. Turn new jobsite launches into a repeatable playbook: hardware logistics, onboarding, integrations, and first-report readiness, coordinated across engineering, operations, and the customer's project team.
  • Nightly Pipeline Operations. Run the operational cadence behind our 5 AM deliverable: incident follow-through, postmortems, and capacity reviews, so reliability improves as volume grows.


Challenges You'll Solve


  • Building process from zero without slowing us down. We move fast and want to keep moving fast. You'll introduce planning and tracking that create clarity, and cut anything that becomes overhead.
  • Making customer commitments predictable. Our customers run billion-dollar jobsites on schedules. You'll make sure the dates we give them are dates we hit.
  • Designing a function that scales. You'll start as a team of one. You'll build the playbooks, tools, and hiring bar for the program management team that follows.


What We're Looking For


  • 5+ years of technical program management, engineering, or a hybrid of both, with at least 3 years running cross-team software programs.
  • You've built planning or delivery process from scratch at a startup or new organization, and it stuck.
  • A strong operator: you run tight meetings, write crisp plans, and follow through relentlessly.
  • A track record of shipping complex programs with hard external deadlines, where you were accountable for the outcome, not just the tracker.
  • Technical fluency to follow engineering tradeoffs and earn engineers' trust.
  • Clear, concise written and verbal communication with engineers, executives, and customers alike.


Preferred Qualifications


  • Prior experience as a software engineer or ML engineer before moving into program management.
  • Experience with ML lifecycle programs: data collection and labeling operations, training and evaluation pipelines, and model launches.
  • Experience with programs that combine hardware and software, such as device fleets, firmware releases, or IoT deployments.
  • Experience leading enterprise customer deployments or third-party integrations.

Location, Compensation, & Perks


  • San Francisco Bay Area (on-site)
  • Base salary: $170k-$240k per year, commensurate with experience
  • Meaningful founding-team equity.
  • Full benefits including health, dental, vision, and 401(k) with 6% match
  • Daily catered lunch
  • Office in San Francisco, next to Oracle Park and the Caltrain

Final compensation is determined by experience, location, and level.

title: Enterprise Architect - Customer and Digital
description:
• Shape the future of NZTA’s customer and digital technology landscape
  • Influence the platforms and capabilities behind customer-facing services
  • Set strategic architecture direction while enabling delivery at pace

Te Whiwhinga mahi | The opportunity

Digital services play a critical role in how NZTA | Waka Kotahi connects with customers, delivers services and shares information with New Zealanders.

We are looking for an experienced Enterprise Architect, Customer and Digital to lead the architecture direction across our Customer and Digital technology domains.


This is a strategic architecture leadership role responsible for defining long-term technology direction, influencing investment decisions and ensuring our digital capabilities evolve in a coherent, scalable and sustainable way.

Working across architecture, product, delivery and technology communities, you will help shape the platforms, capabilities and wider technology landscape supporting NZTA’s customer-focused digital products and services.

In this role, you will:


  • Own the architecture direction for the Customer and Digital technology domains
  • Develop target states, domain roadmaps and strategic technology guidance
  • Shape the evolution of customer experience platforms, digital channels and enabling capabilities
  • Influence technology investment, platform decisions and strategic priorities
  • Provide clear architectural direction to support digital product and service delivery
  • Identify opportunities for simplification, consistency, standardisation and reuse
  • Guide technology standards and architecture practices across the domains
  • Partner with product managers, delivery leaders, solution architects and technology teams
  • Align immediate delivery decisions with long-term strategic outcomes
  • Manage cross-domain dependencies, technology risks and strategic opportunities.

This role sits at the intersection of customer outcomes, digital enablement and enterprise technology strategy. Rather than designing individual solutions, you will establish the strategic technology direction and architectural framework that enable modern, consistent and customer-centred digital experiences.

Success will come from balancing innovation, customer needs and delivery priorities with long-term sustainability and enterprise alignment.

You can find out more about the role in the Position Description.

Ko koe tēnei | About you

You will be an experienced architecture leader who combines strong technology expertise with a clear understanding of customer outcomes and digital service delivery.


To be successful in this role, you will bring:


  • Significant experience in enterprise, solution or technology architecture
  • Experience developing technology strategies, target states and architecture roadmaps
  • Strong knowledge of customer engagement platforms, digital services, web and mobile ecosystems, integration patterns and enabling technologies
  • Experience working across complex product, platform and delivery environments
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and influencing skills
  • The ability to balance long-term strategic direction with practical delivery needs
  • Experience identifying opportunities for simplification, standardisation and platform reuse
  • Strong systems thinking, analysis and problem-solving capabilities
  • The ability to translate complex technology concepts into clear, actionable guidance
  • Excellent communication, collaboration and relationship-building skills

You will be comfortable working across organisational and technology boundaries, navigating competing priorities and providing clear direction where there is complexity or uncertainty.

You will also demonstrate knowledge of, or a willingness to develop an understanding of, Te Ao Māori and promote tikanga and Te Reo Māori. You will also have knowledge of, or a willingness to develop an appreciation of, Te Tiriti o Waitangi and its application within the public service.

Mō mātou | About us

The Chief Technology Office (CTO) is a strategic business enabler within NZTA, providing the digital skills, capabilities, platforms and leadership needed to support our operational performance, regulatory responsibilities and future transport vision.

The CTO helps ensure our digital investments, platforms and services align with organisational priorities and deliver value across NZTA. It plays an important role in enabling efficient service delivery, improving customer experience, managing risk and supporting long-term planning.

As part of Te Aukaha | Digital, you'll contribute to improving our services and decision-making and providing modern, fit-for-purpose digital, information and technology solutions for our people, partners and customers.

You'll be part of an Architecture function that is strengthening its enterprise role, building greater capability to look across NZTA, establish clear direction and enable delivery through stronger standards, patterns and guardrails.


Ka whiwhi koe i te aha | What you will get in return

This is an opportunity to influence the future of how NZTA delivers digital experiences and services to customers across New Zealand.

You will help shape the technology direction for some of NZTA’s most visible digital capabilities, working alongside product, delivery, architecture and technology leaders to ensure digital investments deliver sustainable long-term value.


You will also have the opportunity to:

  • Influence enterprise-level technology direction and investment
  • Shape platforms and services used by customers across New Zealand
  • Work across complex, nationally significant digital environments
  • Enable innovation while strengthening architectural consistency
  • Collaborate with experienced architecture, product and delivery professionals
  • Contribute to meaningful public services and customer outcomes

In addition, you'll benefit from:

  • Flexible working arrangements that support work-life balance
  • Five weeks annual leave
  • Income Protection and Critical Illness Insurance for permanent employees
  • Professional development and career growth opportunities
  • A collaborative and inclusive culture committed to delivering meaningful outcomes for New Zealanders

If you are passionate about customer outcomes, digital strategy and architecture leadership, we would love to hear from you.

title: Data Scientist
description:

Location: Bangalore (On-site)

Job Overview:

We are looking for a Data Scientist with strong hands-on experience in Python, SQL, classical machine learning, and business analytics. The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with relational data, performing statistical analysis, developing machine learning models, and translating business requirements into actionable analytical solutions.

The role primarily focuses on classical machine learning, data analysis, and business-oriented problem-solving rather than Generative AI or LLM-based solutions.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA) and statistical analysis on structured and relational datasets.

  • Develop, implement, and evaluate classical machine learning models.

  • Use Python libraries to process, analyse, and interpret data.

  • Write SQL queries to extract, manipulate, and analyse business data.

  • Apply statistical techniques, hypothesis testing, and analytical methods to solve business problems.

  • Translate business requirements into analytical solutions and actionable insights.

  • Ensure data quality, governance, and compliance standards.

  • Present findings through effective data storytelling and visualisation.



Requirements

Mandatory Requirements:

  • 2–3 years of relevant experience in Data Science.

  • Strong hands-on experience in Python, particularly Pandas, NumPy, and Scikit-learn.

  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational databases.

  • Good understanding of applied statistics, hypothesis testing, and exploratory data analysis (EDA).

  • Knowledge of classical machine learning algorithms and their practical applications.

  • Ability to understand business problems and translate them into analytical solutions.

  • Basic understanding of data governance, data quality, and compliance.

  • Strong communication and data storytelling skills.

Good to Have:

  • Experience with Power BI or Tableau.

  • Basic exposure to Streamlit.

Candidate Preferences:

  • Immediate joiners or candidates who can join within 30 days.

  • Candidates with relevant classical ML and business analytics experience.

  • Candidates primarily focused on GenAI or LLMs will not be suitable.

Work Arrangement: On-site, Bangalore.

title: Clinical Supervisor
description:
Job Summary:

Alpha House is a nonprofit organization dedicated to providing compassionate, evidence-based services that support individuals and families on their journey toward recovery, stability, and self-sufficiency. Through residential and community-based programs, Alpha House empowers those facing substance use and other life challenges by fostering hope, healing, and lasting positive change.

We’re looking for a dedicated and experienced Clinical Supervisor to provide clinical guidance, support staff development, and promote high-quality, effective treatment practices. In this role, you’ll play a key part in mentoring clinical staff, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards, and fostering a collaborative environment focused on delivering quality care and positive client outcomes.

Responsibilities:

  • Clinical Supervision & Staff Development: Provide individual and group supervision to a multidisciplinary team of substance use disorder (SUD) counselors, case managers, and recovery coaches, offering guidance, mentorship, and professional development.
  • Regulatory Compliance: Ensure clinical services meet applicable federal, state, and local regulations, professional standards, and organizational policies.
  • Clinical Documentation: Oversee the quality, accuracy, and timeliness of assessments, treatment plans, progress notes, and discharge summaries.
  • Quality Assurance: Conduct routine audits of clinical documentation and medical records to ensure accuracy, compliance, and appropriate medical necessity.
  • Team Collaboration: Lead case consultations and clinical team meetings while promoting interdisciplinary collaboration to support effective treatment and positive client outcomes.
  • Treatment Planning: Evaluate client progress and guide appropriate levels of care using ASAM criteria to ensure individualized, effective treatment.
  • Direct Clinical Support: Provide guidance on crisis intervention, complex clinical situations, and client care needs, including maintaining a selective caseload or providing direct care when needed.
  • Program Improvement: Support program development, evaluation, and continuous quality improvement initiatives to strengthen clinical services and client outcomes.
  • Care Coordination & Community Partnerships: Coordinate discharge planning and warm handoffs with community partners, housing resources, and aftercare providers. Collaborate with leadership, referral sources, and regulatory agencies to support continuity of care.
  • Recruitment & Onboarding: Participate in hiring, training, and onboarding clinical staff to build and maintain a strong, effective clinical team.
Qualifications:
  • Master’s degree in Counseling, Social Work, Psychology, or a related behavioral health field required.
  • Appropriate clinical licensure or certification in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements (e.g., LPC, LCSW, or CAADC).

title: Life and Workforce Readiness Director
description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

This position supports the work of the Y, a leading nonprofit charitable organization committed to strengthening community through youth development, healthy living, and social responsibility. The Life & Workforce Readiness Director provides strategic leadership for all life skills, workforce development, and teen programming at Greater Holyoke YMCA, serving members ages 12-18. Reporting to Senior Program Director, this role is responsible for designing, delivering, and expanding a continuum of programming that moves young people through three intentional stages — Explore, Develop, and Apply — from early curiosity and foundational skill-building in areas of Academic Success, Health & Well-being, Character & Leadership and Life & Workforce Readiness with an end goal of career exploration, hands-on training, industry certifications, and real-world work experience.


OUR CULTURE:

Our mission and core values are brought to life by our culture. In the Y, we strive to live our cause of strengthening communities with purpose and intentionality every day. We are welcoming: we are open to all. We are a place where you can belong and become. We are genuine: we value you and embrace your individuality. We are hopeful: we believe in you and your potential to become a catalyst in the world. We are nurturing and we support you in your journey to develop your full potential. We are determined: above all else, we are on a relentless quest to make our community stronger, beginning with you.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Recruit, hire, develop, train, and supervise staff as well as volunteers
  • Responsible for the design and implementation of diverse teen programming, including YUSA national programs, college and career exploration, mentoring, and certified workforce training and other evidence-based curricula
  • Develop additional program offerings and expand the program portfolio in response to workforce trends, community needs, and emerging partner opportunities.
  • Manage all data and teen program outcome tracking for grant and contract reporting requirements
  • Work with each department to provide training, mentoring, workforce readiness support, and other resources to all junior staff ages 18 years and under
  • Develop, implement, and monitor the program budget to meet fiscal objectives.
  • Establish and maintain relationships with service providers in various settings, including other CBOs, schools, and partnerships; serve as liaison for City of Holyoke Youth Task Force and other community wide committees
  • Create and support an environment that is diverse, culturally sensitive, and relevant to the needs of teens.
  • Manage adolescent behavior with respect, maturity, compassion, and encouragement.
  • Support Youth Services department with additional Early Education & Care and Out of School Time responsibilities on an as needed basis


LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES:

  • Communication & Influence: Listens and expresses self effectively and in a way that engages, inspires, and builds commitment to the Y’s cause.
  • Inclusion: Values all people for their unique talents and takes an active role in promoting practices that support diversity, inclusion, and global work, as well as cultural competence.
  • Critical Thinking & Decision Making: Makes informed decisions based on logic, data, and sound judgment.
  • Functional Expertise: Executes superior technical skills for the role.
  • Innovation: Creates and implements new and relevant approaches and activities that improve and expand the Y’s work and impact in the community.
  • Program/Project Management: Ensures program or project goals are met and intended impact occurs.
  • Developing Self & Others: Develops self and supports others (e.g., staff, volunteers, members, program participants), both formally and informally, to achieve their highest potential.
  • Emotional Maturity: Demonstrates ability to understand and manage emotions effectively in all situations.

title: Falcon søger Senior Softwareudvikler
description:
Falcon er vokset hurtigt de seneste år, og i dag forvalter vi mere end 1,6 mia. kr. i vores investerings- og porteføljeplejeløsninger.

Bag rådgivningen ligger der en teknisk platform, som vi selv har bygget. Den indeholder dataintegrationer mod banker og depotbanker, en central database, en kundeportal, automatiseret rapportering og en voksende række AI-værktøjer. Platformen bruges hver dag og skal nu videreudvikles, så den kan understøtte Falcons fortsatte vækst.

Derfor søger vi en erfaren softwareudvikler til vores kontor i Aarhus, som finder det spændende og naturligt at tage det fulde ejerskab over platformen og stå i spidsen for udviklingen fremover.

Du får ansvaret for platformen

Du sætter den tekniske retning for vores IT-udvikling i tæt samarbejde med investeringschefen og vores eksterne udviklingspartner. Du skriver selv kode, planlægger og driver udviklingsprojekter og træffer centrale valg om arkitektur og teknologi.

Du får frihed til at vælge værktøjer og arbejdsform. Til gengæld forventer vi, at det du bygger er robust, sikkert og til at vedligeholde.

Hos Falcon bruger vi aktivt AI til udviklingen. Vi søger en udvikler, der kan kombinere den hastighed med stærk teknisk dømmekraft, kodegennemgang og ansvar for løsninger i produktion. Vi forventer, at du er på forkant med udviklingen, og at du kan sætte de rammer for sikkerhed, kvalitet og kontrol, som en finansiel virksomhed under tilsyn kræver.

Dine vigtigste opgaver:

Du kommer blandt andet til at:

  • eje og videreudvikle vores dataplatform, kundeportal og interne værktøjer
  • planlægge og eksekvere nye udviklingsprojekter
  • bygge og vedligeholde integrationer mod bankers og depotbankers API’er og datafeeds
  • stå i spidsen for de platform- og infrastrukturvalg, der skal bære os de kommende år
  • udvikle AI-agenter og automatisering, der gør analyse, rapportering og kontroller hurtigere og mere præcise
  • løfte vores udviklingspraksis med tests, CI/CD, overvågning og dokumentation
  • være teknisk sparringspartner for ledelsen.

Vi bygger i dag primært i Python og PostgreSQL med web-API’er og cloud-hosting. Du får stor indflydelse på, hvordan platformen og infrastrukturen skal udvikle sig.

Efter 3–6 måneder har du sat dit præg på platformen

Det vil sige, at du:

  • har overtaget ansvaret og kender platformen til bunds
  • har lagt en teknisk udviklingsplan og er godt i gang med at eksekvere den
  • har leveret de første nye projekter i produktion
  • har gjort platformen mere robust og lettere at videreudvikle

Vi leder efter en udvikler, der tager ejerskab

Du har flere års erfaring med softwareudvikling og har haft ansvar for systemer i drift. Din baggrund kan være fra en softwarevirksomhed, et konsulenthus, en fintechvirksomhed eller en bank. Det afgørende er, at du kan tage ansvar og få løsninger til at fungere i praksis.

Vi lægger især vægt på, at du:



har solid erfaring med databaser, datamodellering og API-integrationer.



har praktisk erfaring med cloud, drift og DevOps.



bruger kodeagenter og AI-værktøjer som en naturlig del af dit arbejde.



kan drive projekter selvstændigt og prioritere mellem nye funktioner og tekniske forbedringer.



kommunikerer klart og trives med tæt kontakt til dem, der bruger det, du bygger.



Interesse for investering og finansielle data er en fordel. Erfaring fra finans er ikke et krav.

Et lille team med stor faglig bredde

Du bliver en del af Falcon-teamet på 12 medarbejdere. Vi har kontor centralt i Århus, og i det daglige vil du arbejde tæt sammen med investeringschef Niels Hovmøller og vores eksterne udviklingspartner. Sammen udgør I kernen i Falcons IT-udvikling.

Der er kort fra idé til beslutning og fra beslutning til produktion. Hvis du ser noget, der kan gøres bedre, forventer vi, at du siger det og gør noget ved det. Tonen er uformel og ærlig, men altid ordentlig og respektfuld.

Du får desuden mulighed for at blive medejer af Falcon Fondsmæglerselskab, blandt andet gennem vores medarbejderaktieprogram, så du kan få del i den værdi, du er med til at skabe.

Om Falcon

Falcon Fondsmæglerselskab A/S er underlagt tilsyn af Finanstilsynet. Vi rådgiver privatpersoner, familier, selskaber og fonde om investering og formueforhold, og vi tilbyder både investeringsrådgivning og personlig porteføljepleje.

Falcon er desuden investeringsrådgiver for tre børsnoterede investeringsfonde med ca. 3.500 investorer: Falcon Danske Aktier, Falcon Brighter Future og Annox Kvant Globale Aktier. Vores løsninger omfatter Falcon Invest, Falcon Porteføljepleje og Falcon Formuerådgivning.

Læs mere om Falcon på .

Skal vi tale om, hvad du kan bygge hos Falcon?

Send dit CV til investeringschef Niels Hovmøller på nh@falconfms.dk. Tiltrædelse er hurtigst muligt, og vi behandler ansøgninger løbende. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte Niels på mobil 42 94 29 87.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig.

Falcon Fondsmæglerselskab A/S er et uafhængigt alternativ til bankerne, når det drejer sig om formuerådgivning, investering og porteføljepleje. Vi er under tilsyn af Finanstilsynet.

Vi tilbyder personlig og uafhængig formuerådgivning, investeringsrådgivning og porteføljepleje til privatpersoner og deres familier. Vi rådgiver desuden investeringsfonde og samarbejder med en række finansielle partnere.

title: AI Engineer - On-site Copenhagen
description:
**AI Engineer

**AI is moving from prototypes to production-ready solutions. The engineers who can take it there matter more than ever.

At Heyra, we build operational AI: systems, workflows, and data platforms that live in production from day one. We work with companies that are moving quickly and need solutions that improve the way they operate.

We're looking for an AI Engineer who is as comfortable in the code as in the data underneath it. Someone who can design, build, and ship AI solutions today, and grow into setting technical direction as the company grows.

On smaller engagements, you may be the only engineer on the project, which means owning it from problem to production yourself. On larger ones, you'll work closely with engineers, data specialists, strategists, and designers in a company where ideas move quickly, and the distance from thinking to building is intentionally small.

What you'll work on

  • Designing and deploying AI solutions across domains like finance, operations, and supply chain
  • Building predictive models, automated workflows, and agentic systems
  • Owning the data work behind your own models and agents
  • Building eval systems that measure whether an agent actually works
  • Leading client projects from problem to production
  • Translating business needs into AI solutions that actually ship
  • Integrating scalable AI systems through APIs and cloud environments

**Requirements

****You probably have experience with

**

  • Software development, ML or data engineering, with AI applications running in production
  • Fluent Python and at least one agent framework or SDK
  • Training ML models and handling the data preparation behind them
  • Building or extending eval systems for agent behaviour
  • Building scalable systems in cloud environments like Azure or GCP
  • Coding with agents such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor
  • Stakeholder management and leading delivery end-to-end

Curiosity, taste and builder mentality matter just as much to us as specific tools or years of experience.

Why Heyra

We believe consulting needs to be rewritten. We are building a consultancy designed for the agentic era. We design, build and operate AI products that change how enterprises work, from problem to prototype to production.

Heyra brings together people from engineering, strategy, product, startup and creative environments. We keep teams small, collaboration close and momentum high. We care deeply about craft, speed and building things that work in the real world.

People here care about what they build. Good ideas move quickly. New technology gets explored early. There is room to shape both the company and the way we work.

We are around 45 people today, and we are only just getting started.

If this sounds like your kind of work, send us a short note about yourself together with your CV. We care much more about curiosity, energy and the way you think than polished applications.

**Benefits

**

  • Healthcare insurance
  • Pension plan
  • Parental leave
  • Social gatherings
  • New tech gear
  • Central office
  • Free lunch, coffee, snacks, and Friday beers
  • Skill development
  • Paid holiday
  • Remote work allowed
  • Pet friendly

Har du blik for detaljen, og trives du med at skabe struktur og få processer til at fungere? Så har du mulighed for at blive en del af Rekvirentcenteret ved Hjemmeværnskommandoen, hvor samarbejde, faglighed og initiativ er en vigtig del af hverdagen.

Om os

Ressource- og Støtteafdelingen i Hjemmeværnskommandoen består på nuværende tidspunkt af ca. 19 medarbejdere. Du bliver en del af et mindre, men stærkt Rekvirent-team med højt fagligt niveau og fokus på samarbejde og gode løsninger. Vores Rekvirentcenter er en del af Hjemmeværnsstaben som er placeret på Vordingborg Kaserne.

Hos os får du mulighed for at bringe dine færdigheder i spil og udvikle dig både fagligt og personligt. Vi tror på, at medarbejdernes kompetencer bedst udnyttes gennem tillid, fleksibilitet og løbende kompetenceudvikling.

Kerneværdierne i vores afdeling er:

  • Samarbejdsevne
  • Helhedsforståelse
  • Selvstændighed
  • Høj faglighed

Om stillingen

Som rekvirent får du en vigtig rolle i udviklingen af Hjemmeværnets Rekvirentcenter og den videre operative drift. Du skal medvirke til rettidigt, og på baggrund af myndighedernes behov, at oprette rekvisitioner/bestillinger i Forsvarets fælles SAP ERP-system.

Før en rekvisition i Hjemmeværnet bliver til et indkøb, skal rekvisitionen behandles hos Forsvarsministeriets Materiel- og Indkøbsstyrelse. Dette betyder at du i din dagligdag skal være i tæt dialog med denne styrelse for at tilsikre, at indkøbet gennemføres jævnfør gældende regler.

Samtidig skal du som rekvirent kunne arbejde systematisk og holde styr på de mange forskellige input, der kan komme fra både behovsindehaver og indkøbere.

Dine primære opgaver bliver at:

  • Oprette rekvisitioner i Forsvarets fælles SAP ERP-system.
  • Dialog og støtte til underlagte myndigheder og distrikter omkring indkøb.
  • Tilsikre at statens rammeaftaler overholdes.
  • Løbende udvikling af Rekvirentcenteret så det omfatter alle hjemmeværnets myndigheder.
  • Gennemføre elektronisk varemodtagelse når varen er modtaget.
  • Fakturahåndtering i SAP.
  • Sagsbehandle uplacerbare fakturaer.

Om dig

Det er væsentligt for at trives i stillingen at du har interesse og forståelse for processer, et godt serviceniveau, tager ejerskab for opgaven og har gode kommunikative evner.

Vi forestiller os, at du har en administrativ uddannelse eller baggrund.

Det forudsættes, at du tager de fornødne interne uddannelser, så du opnår teknisk viden, samt at du opnår forståelse for den proces, hvori du sidder. Du skal kunne samarbejde på tværs af organisationen, og du sætter en ære i altid at have ”styr på pudsekassen”.

Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring på området fra en tidligere indkøbsrelateret stilling i enten Forsvaret, eller anden offentlig såvel som privat organisation - men det er ikke et krav. Du vil blive oplært og klædt på til opgaven, der forudsætter at du bringer dine IT-færdigheder i spil.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du:

  • Arbejder selvstændigt og struktureret.
  • Har forståelse for organisationsstrukturer og samarbejde på tværs.
  • Er initiativrig, fleksibel og udviklingsorienteret.
  • Er rutineret til at opbygge og vedligeholde netværk.

Vi tilbyder:

  • Stor indflydelse på egen arbejdstilrettelæggelse.
  • Et engageret og udviklingsorienteret arbejdsmiljø.
  • Gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling.
  • En bred samarbejdsflade og varierede opgaver.
  • Mulighed for hjemmearbejde.

Ansættelsesvilkår

Ansættelsen sker i henhold til den til enhver tid gældende Fællesoverenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og Offentligt Ansattes Organisationer – Det Statslige Område (OAO-S-fællesoverenskomsten) og organisationsaftale for kontorfunktionærer, laboranter og it-medarbejdere.

Afhængigt af dine kvalifikationer og kompetencer, er der mulighed for forhandling af tillæg. Der er til stillingen knyttet en arbejdsgiverfinansieret pensionsordning.

Stillingen er med fast tjenestested i Vordingborg.

Som ansat under Forsvarsministeriets område er du omfattet af nogle særlige vilkår. Du skal bl.a. kunne sikkerhedsgodkendes og opretholde sikkerhedsgodkendelsen under hele ansættelsesforholdet.

Du har som ansat pligt til at forrette tjeneste uden for landets grænser, herunder ved enheder i internationale operationer med henblik på deltagelse i konfliktforebyggende, fredsbevarende, fredsskabende, humanitære og andre lignende operationer.

Kontakt og ansøgning

Hvis du vil høre mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte kontorfuldmægtig Bente Birkbak på telefon 6150 3430 eller på mail HJK-RSA-RS06@mil.dk.

Har du spørgsmål til løn- og ansættelsesvilkår er du velkommen til at kontakte Personelkommandoen, HR-konsulent Mathias Fonskov på 3266 5657.

Ansøgningsfrist er den 8. november 2026. Samtaler forventes afholdt i uge 46 og 47.

Tiltrædelse: 1. januar 2027 eller efter aftale.

Du søger stillingen via linket og vi beder dig vedhæfte ansøgning, CV og kopi af uddannelsesbevis. Vær opmærksom på at bilag skal tilføjes i PDF-format.

I Forsvarsministeriets organisation tror vi på, at mangfoldighed optimerer opgaveløsningen. Derfor opfordrer vi alle interesserede uanset baggrund til at søge stillingen.

Om Hjemmeværnskommandoen

Hjemmeværnet er en frivillig, militær beredskabsorganisation. Hjemmeværnskommandoen er Hjemmeværnets øverste myndighed og er en værnsfælles styrelse under Forsvarsministeriet. Hjemmeværnskommandoen er ansvarlige for den strategiske og operative ledelse af Hjemmeværnet som organisation og omfatter Chefen for Hjemmeværnet og den Kommitterede for Hjemmeværnet, der tilsammen udgør Hjemmeværnsledelsen, samt Hjemmeværnsstaben.

Hjemmeværnskommandoen er ansvarlige for opstilling og uddannelse af frivilligt personel og enheder og deltager som en del af det militære forsvar i løsningen af de flere af de opgaver, der påhviler Hæren, Søværnet, Flyvevåbnet samt disses hjælp til civile myndigheder. Hjemmeværnskommandoen står for kommunikation om Hjemmeværnet, strategisk rekruttering og tilknytning af frivillige, udarbejdelse af planer og programmer samt gennemførelse af studievirksomhed for Hjemmeværnets udvikling. Hjemmeværnskommandoen med Hjemmeværnsstab, divisioner og afdelinger har hovedkvarter på Vordingborg Kaserne, men har satellitter flere steder i landet.

title: Cloud - Network Engineer
description:
• Opportunity to join a high-performing team in a fixed-term capacity
  • Hybrid Work Environment: Work where we work best – whether in the office or from home
  • Based from our Sydney CBD office

Perpetual Wealth

Perpetual Wealth consists of three distinct brands in addition to Perpetual Private – Fordham, Jacaranda Financial Planning and Priority Life – offering a unique mix of wealth management, advice and trustee services. Our diverse capabilities include strategic advice on superannuation and retirement planning, general investment, asset protection, insurance, tax management, estate planning, aged care, social security, succession planning and philanthropy. Our clients include individuals, families, businesses, not-for-profit organisations and Indigenous communities throughout Australia.


As part of an exciting new chapter, Perpetual Wealth will soon become a standalone business following the recently announced acquisition by Bain Capital. This creates a unique opportunity to join a business focused on growth, innovation and delivering exceptional outcomes for clients.

About the Role

Join our dynamic team at Perpetual Wealth as a Cloud Network Engineer. You will bring a strong background in cloud-based networking concepts, technologies and solutions, with expertise in managing a variety of network security and optimisation tools. This is a crucial operations role supporting our network infrastructure, ensuring reliability, availability, security and performance.


  • Configure and manage firewalls, appliances and other network devices to enforce security policies and optimise network traffic
  • Deploy and manage SD-WAN network products, optimising connectivity and performance across distributed locations
  • Monitor and analyse network traffic, performance and security events, identifying and mitigating potential issues and vulnerabilities
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement network architectures that support business requirements and objectives
  • Troubleshoot and resolve network issues, providing timely and effective support to end users and stakeholders
  • Implement and maintain network security controls and protocols to protect against cyber threats and unauthorised access
  • Develop and maintain accurate, complete network documentation, diagrams and configurations
  • Support projects to ensure network solutions align with network service strategies, frameworks, policies and practices
  • Provide architecture oversight for key projects and initiatives
  • Develop network artefacts for cloud environments (especially Microsoft)
  • Participate in design forums and architecture governance, providing guidance to ensure solution designs are implemented correctly and standards are adhered to
  • Lead service lifecycle governance, maintaining network roadmaps and plans on behalf of the Technology Services Manager to ensure service lifecycle events are well managed
  • Collaborate with ITSM and DevOps SMEs to create and maintain definitions and a catalogue of network services

About You

We’re looking for someone with:

  • A bachelor’s degree in IT, preferably with a major in Networking
  • Certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, CCIE, Checkpoint CCSA, Checkpoint CCSE or Azure are a plus
  • Framework certifications such as ITIL, PRINCE2, COBIT, TOGAF or similar are highly desirable
  • A minimum of 5 years’ experience managing Checkpoint firewalls, Netskope appliances, Azure networking, Citrix ADCs and SD-WAN networks based on Meraki products
  • A strong understanding of cloud-based networking concepts, architectures and technologies, including virtual networks, VPNs, load balancers and DNS
  • Essential experience with Microsoft Azure; experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS) or Google Cloud Platform (GCP) is a plus
  • Strong knowledge of Linux and Windows operating systems
  • Proficiency in network routing and switching protocols, including BGP, OSPF, VLANs and MPLS
  • A solid understanding of network security principles and best practices, including encryption, authentication and access control

How we work
Our unique culture is underpinned by our three organisational behaviours, Stretch, Own it, Make an impact which drive our approach of day-to-day interactions with colleagues and clients, the way we approach decision-making to the questions we ask and the problems we solve.

Employee benefits

  • Work from anywhere in Australia for up to one month each year
  • An annual allowance to empower you to prioritise your personal wellbeing
  • Study support and commitment to supporting professional development


We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace where diversity is celebrated. No matter your background or circumstances, we aim to provide an environment where you can thrive.

title: Strategic Retention Partner
description:
Strategic Retention Partner – 12-18 Month Maternity Cover

Compass Group UK & Ireland
Strategic Accounts / Business & Industry
Remote, hybrid or mobile working
Competitive salary

The opportunity

We’re looking for an accomplished Strategic Retention Partner to protect, strengthen and grow some of our most valuable client relationships.

This is a senior, client-facing commercial role in which you’ll build trusted relationships with key decision-makers, understand what matters most to their organisations and turn that insight into effective retention, renewal and growth strategies.

Working independently from day-to-day operational delivery, you’ll connect clients with our operational leadership, sales, commercial and bid teams. You’ll bring together the right people around a clear plan, ensuring feedback is acted upon, risks are addressed early and opportunities to deepen our partnerships are pursued.

If you combine commercial judgement with exceptional relationship-building skills and can challenge constructively while taking people with you, this is an opportunity to make a significant impact.

What you’ll be doing

Protecting and extending client partnerships

  • Own the retention strategy for a portfolio of high-value strategic accounts.
  • Develop evidence-led plans for contract retention, renewals, competitive tenders and pre-emptive extensions.
  • Identify emerging risks early and ensure actions, ownership and timescales are clear.
  • Lead strategic conversations with key client decision-makers.
  • Help operational teams understand clients’ critical business priorities and turn insight into practical action.

Building trusted senior relationships

  • Act as a strategic point of contact for key clients, working alongside but independently from operational delivery.
  • Build credibility and trust with senior stakeholders, decision-makers and influencers.
  • Develop stakeholder maps and structured engagement plans for allocated accounts.
  • Use client interviews, feedback and business reviews to identify improvement opportunities and retention risks.
  • Keep conversations focused on long-term partnership value, not simply day-to-day issue resolution.

Leading renewals and re-tenders

  • Set the strategic direction for allocated re-tenders, renewals and extension opportunities.
  • Identify the client’s must-win issues and ensure they shape proposals, presentations and commercial solutions.
  • Work closely with operational, bid, sales, commercial and specialist teams to develop credible and deliverable responses.
  • Provide constructive challenge to strengthen the proposed solution.
  • Lead, support or coach presentation preparation and apply lessons from previous outcomes to future retention activity.

Identifying commercial opportunities

  • Find opportunities to extend, deepen and grow existing partnerships.
  • Work with sales, operations and sector leadership to explore organic growth, cross-selling and value creation.
  • Bring forward ideas that address clients’ wider business priorities.
  • Develop strategic client roadmaps with clear priorities, milestones and actions.
  • Balance commercial opportunity with client satisfaction, operational deliverability and long-term retention.

Turning insight into action

  • Maintain accurate client relationship, risk and action records within CRM systems.
  • Use client feedback and reporting to identify early warning signs and areas requiring intervention.
  • Create clear ownership and follow-through from client conversations and account reviews.
  • Translate complex client insight into practical recommendations for operational teams and senior leadership.
  • Work as a credible critical friend, supporting colleagues while providing objective, client-led challenge.

What we’re looking for

You’ll be a confident and credible relationship-builder who can operate successfully with senior clients, commercial colleagues and operational leadership teams.

Essential experience and capabilities

  • Strong relationship-building skills with senior client stakeholders and operational teams.
  • Commercial acumen, including an understanding of contract value, margin protection and retention risk.
  • Experience in a client-facing, operational, sales, retention or account-management environment.
  • Confidence to challenge constructively and hold stakeholders to account.
  • The ability to interpret client feedback and turn it into meaningful action.
  • Strong communication, presentation and stakeholder-management skills.
  • A structured approach to planning, CRM management, relationship mapping and follow-through.
  • Resilience, self-sufficiency and the ability to remain effective under pressure.

It would be an advantage if you also have

  • A background in hospitality, foodservice, facilities management or a related sector.
  • Experience of bids, re-tenders, pre-emptive extensions or complex contract renewals.
  • Familiarity with structured client-retention and relationship-mapping processes.
  • Experience supporting multi-site contracts and working with senior clients and operational leadership teams.

What success looks like

You’ll quickly establish trust across our client and internal stakeholder communities. You’ll anticipate where an account is heading, bring risks and opportunities forward early and use commercial insight to support sound decision-making.

Ultimately, your success will be reflected in stronger client relationships, effective retention and extension strategies, disciplined account planning and the identification of sustainable opportunities to deepen and grow our partnerships.

Apply now

If you’re a commercially astute relationship-builder who can influence at a senior level, challenge with credibility and turn client insight into action, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now to join Compass Group UK & Ireland as our Strategic Retention Partner on a 12-18 month maternity cover contract.

title: Work Study - Student Affairs
description:
Who We Are:

Are you ready to work at a dynamic institution that believes in higher education with lower obstacles? Franklin Cummings Tech is a nationally accredited nonprofit technical college serving Massachusetts. Rooted in Benjamin Franklin’s 1791 bequest to expand access to apprenticeship and entrepreneurship, the college provides accessible technical and trade education that advances economic opportunity. We seek dedicated colleagues who are excited to support student success and a welcoming campus community.


Position Summary:

The Student Affairs Work-Study Assistant supports student-facing programs and daily operations across the areas overseen by the Office of Student Support & Wellness: campus activities and orientation, student clubs and leadership, wellness and basic needs, accessibility and accommodations administration, tutoring and academic support, and student resource referrals. Working under staff supervision, the student assistant helps create a welcoming, organized, and inclusive campus experience.


Essential Functions and Responsibilities:

· Assist with planning and staffing campus activities, orientation, student clubs, and Franklin Leaders programming, including event setup, check-in, and breakdown.

· Support wellness programming, resource displays, and approved outreach related to student well-being, food access, and other basic needs.

· Help maintain the food pantry and departmental supplies through inventory checks, restocking, organization, and expiration-date monitoring.

· Provide administrative support for accessibility services by organizing general materials, helping with scheduling, and directing accommodation inquiries to authorized staff.

· Promote tutoring and academic support by sharing approved schedules, preparing materials, and helping coordinate tutoring spaces and activities.

· Assist with front-desk coverage, greeting students, answering general questions, maintaining calendars and records, and connecting students with appropriate staff and campus or community resources.

· Create draft flyers, signage, and student communications; organize files and event materials; and complete other assigned projects, subject to supervisor approval and confidentiality requirements.


Student workers do not make accommodation decisions, provide counseling, or independently access confidential student case files. All external communications and purchases require supervisor approval.

description:
Axiom builds the digital and electrical infrastructure powering the AI era. We design, build and deploy integrated power, thermal and compute solutions that help data centers, utilities and innovators scale faster, operate more efficiently and meet growing demand.


Built on decades of manufacturing expertise, global operations and a proven ability to deliver complex systems at scale, Axiom combines innovation with real-world execution. We're helping close the gap between what the future demands and what the world can deliver.

Job Summary

To support our extraordinary teams who build great products and contribute to our growth, we’re looking to add a Sr FA Engineer located in shenzhen.


Reporting to the Director, the Sr FA Engineer role involves…



What a typical day looks like:


  • Conduct failure analysis for AC/DC, DC/DC and LLC power supplies, diagnose electrical failures and propose solutions.
  • Test power modules with oscilloscopes, multimeters and other tools, analyze the design issues or component failures on PCBA level.
  • Analyze test log, CPK data, BI log data, and report findings.
  • Support pilot production, troubleshoot for production defects, provide repair guidelines and technical documentations.
  • Collaborate with R&D teams to optimize designs, ensuring compliance with safety and EMC standards.
  • Prepare bilingual FA reports and present findings to clients or internal teams.
  • Plan and improve failure analysis capability and capacity continuously, including training technicians.

The experience we’re looking to add to our team:

  • Bachelor’s degree or above in Electrical or Power Electronic engineering etc.
  • Good English listening, writing & speaking.
  • 3 to 5+ years of experience in power supply failure analysis techniques.
  • Proficient in switch-mode power supply topologies (BUCK, BOOST, Flyback, Forward and so on) and failure analysis techniques.
  • Experience with PSUs, including AC/DC, DC/DC converters, and power factor correction (PFC) circuits is plus
  • Experience with BBUs, including BMS(battery management system), DC/DC converters, and battery testing, such as charge/discharge cycles is plus
  • Experience with power shelves, racks, and PSCs is plus
  • A deep understanding of electrical components and power electronics.
  • Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and excellent problem-solving abilities to identify root causes of failures.

title: Associate Director - Tech Product Owner (ePI)
description:
About the Team:

Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise.

Enterprise Systems Management & Business Operations delivers digital solutions that support Enterprise Systems running as a high-performing organisation. This team drives financial discipline, operational rigour and strategic alignment across the ES portfolio that safeguard GSK’s integrity and reputation globally. By joining this team, you’ll help shape systems that support thousands of employees worldwide, driving innovation and reliability in the tools that keep GSK moving forward.

Job Purpose:

· The Associate Director - Tech Product Owner (ePI) provides product leadership for Electronic Product Information, translating business strategy and user needs into a clear product vision, measurable outcomes, and an actionable roadmap. Role leads cross-functional delivery across the product lifecycle, making evidence-based decisions within strategic, financial, risk, and architectural guardrails.

· The Associate Director - Tech Product Owner (ePI) works with delivery teams to ensure requirements are clear, value-driven, and data-informed, while overseeing iterative delivery that improves product performance, adoption, and operational readiness

Key Responsibilities:

· Create, own, and communicate the product vision and multi-year roadmap, translating strategic priorities, user needs, regulatory requirements, technical dependencies, and investment constraints into sequenced outcomes.

· Build and manage effective relationships with business stakeholders, regulatory teams and external partners; understand their needs, translate them into clear product outcomes and requirements, and maintain alignment throughout delivery.

· Own and manage the Product backlog, ensuring requirements (e.g., epics, features, user stories) are well-defined and supported by minimum data inputs (e.g., cost drivers, user volumes, risk/sensitivity, process impact, dependencies).

· Lead your team in using approved AI tools to improve productivity and ways of working, including discovery, backlog refinement and requirements drafting. Role-model responsible use, ensure AI-assisted outputs are reviewed before acceptance, and follow GSK’s Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements.

· Make prioritisation decisions for the Product backlog based on value, cost, risk, business continuity, and resource capacity, escalating only where strategic trade-offs are required.

· Lead the Product team’s delivery activities. Build shared understanding of the product vision and roadmap, resolve ambiguity and competing priorities, and guide the team toward solutions that are fit-for-purpose, secure, compliant, supportable, and aligned with architectural standards.

· Drive operational readiness by applying a delivery readiness checklist covering support model requirements, training needs, continuity planning, configuration/runbook documentation, release notes, and user onboarding.

· Define and maintain the Product performance dashboard, tracking adoption, cycle time/throughput, stability/defects, and support effort; use performance insights to drive continuous improvement.

· Ensure product changes follow required security controls, risk assessments, data handling policies, and regulated change processes, obtaining approvals from relevant SMEs where required.

· Ensure the product and its changes comply with applicable GxP requirements, including computerised system validation, data integrity, controlled documentation, and regulated change control, obtaining approval from relevant quality and compliance SMEs where required.

· Lead technical deep dives with Engineers, Solution Architects, security specialists, and vendors to evaluate solution options, constraints, dependencies, scalability, supportability, and total cost of ownership. Use this analysis to make or recommend evidence-based product decisions, challenge assumptions constructively, and ensure technical choices remain aligned with the product vision, enterprise architecture, regulatory requirements, and long-term roadmap.

· Act as an escalation point for the Product team and business users on functional product issues, guiding decisions within agreed financial, risk, and architectural guardrails.

· Own product-level financial planning and control within agreed guardrails, including budget forecasting, cost tracking, investment proposals, vendor spend, and benefits realisation. Provide transparent financial reporting, identify variances and cost pressures early, and recommend trade-offs to maximise product value and maintain alignment with portfolio priorities.

· Typically 7+ years of experience working in product delivery, digital solutions, business systems, or process-led technology roles.

· Experience developing PoCs, PoVs, MVPs, and business value validation models.

· Proven stakeholder management, communication, facilitation, and influencing skills, with the ability to explain complex business, regulatory, and technology topics clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred:

title: Catering Assistant - Kitchen
description:
Are you someone who enjoys working with fresh food, takes pride in quality and presentation, and likes being part of a friendly, hardworking team?

We're looking for an enthusiastic and reliable Part-Time Catering Assistant to join our Eurest kitchen team.

This is primarily a back-of-house food preparation role, with responsibility for producing the fresh sandwiches, wraps, Panini's and deli products that form our daily deli bar offer.

You'll play an important part in making sure our food is freshly prepared, beautifully presented and ready for our customers each day.

Your working pattern

This is a 20-hour-per-week position working Monday to Wednesday.

Shifts will start between 6:00am and 7:00am, with finish times between 12:00pm and 1:00pm, depending on operational requirements.

The working days are fixed, and applicants must be available to work the advertised Monday to Wednesday working pattern on an ongoing basis.

As this is an early-morning production role, reliability and excellent timekeeping are particularly important

What you'll be doing

Your key responsibilities will include:

Preparing and producing a fresh daily range of sandwiches, wraps and deli products.
Preparing ingredients including meats, cheeses, salads, fillings and accompaniments.
Following recipes, specifications and agreed production quantities to ensure consistency.
Making sure products are prepared on time and our deli bar is fully stocked and ready for service.
Maintaining excellent standards of food quality, portion control and presentation.
Helping create attractive food and deli displays that showcase our offer.
Ensuring all products are correctly labelled, dated and stored.
Following all food safety, allergen and food hygiene procedures.
Maintaining high standards of cleanliness throughout food preparation and kitchen areas.
Following all relevant Health & Safety procedures and safe working practices.
Monitoring stock levels and following appropriate stock rotation procedures.
Helping us minimise food waste through careful preparation and production.
Supporting our chefs and wider kitchen team with additional food preparation when required.
Working efficiently to ensure daily production is completed within the required timescales.
Proudly representing Eurest and contributing to a positive, professional and supportive working environment.

What we're looking for

We're looking for someone who will bring a positive attitude and take pride in the food they produce.

Our ideal Catering Assistant will:

Be reliable, punctual and able to commit to the advertised Monday to Wednesday working pattern.
Be comfortable working early morning shifts, including starts from 6:00am.
Have a positive, proactive and can-do attitude.
Enjoy working with food and care about quality and presentation.
Have excellent attention to detail.
Be organised and able to manage their time effectively.
Work well both independently and as part of a supportive kitchen team.
Be comfortable working in a busy, fast-paced environment and meeting production deadlines.
Understand the importance of food hygiene, allergen management and Health & Safety.
Be flexible and willing to support the wider kitchen operation when required.

Previous experience in catering, food preparation, sandwich production or a kitchen environment would be an advantage, but it isn't essential. We're equally interested in people with the right attitude, reliability and enthusiasm to learn.

title: Software Engineer til Channel Assembly & Distribution i TV 2
description:
Vær med til at bygge fremtidens distributionsplatforme for TV 2s indhold

TV 2 søger en Software Engineer, der vil være med til at bygge fremtidens distributionsplatforme for TV 2s indhold.

Du kommer til at arbejde med teknologi, der gør TV 2 i stand til at klargøre, berige, beskytte og distribuere indhold til seerne på tværs af tv-kanaler, TV 2 Play og øvrige platforme.

Om Channel Assembly & Distribution

Channel Assembly & Distribution bygger og driver de løsninger, der samler indhold til færdige tv-kanaler og sikrer levering til både traditionelle og digitale platforme.

Vi arbejder med live- og VOD-distribution, metadata, indholdsbeskyttelse og cloudbaserede distributionsplatforme i krydsfeltet mellem software engineering, streaming og broadcast.

Du behøver ikke kende medie- eller broadcastbranchen. Det vigtigste er, at du er dygtig til softwareudvikling og komplekse systemer, der skal fungere stabilt hver dag.

Hvis du er nysgerrig på vores verden, arbejder vi blandt andet med:

  • Cloudbaserede distributionsplatforme
  • Live- og VOD-distribution
  • Streamingprotokoller og medieworkflows
  • Indholdsbeskyttelse og rettighedsstyring
  • Automatisering af kritiske produktions- og distributionsflows

Samtidig arbejder vi målrettet på at modernisere vores platforme gennem cloud-native arkitekturer, automatisering og softwaredefinerede workflows.

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • har 3-5 års erfaring som Software Engineer eller tilsvarende.
  • har erfaring med cloud-native løsninger og AWS.
  • har arbejdet med Infrastructure as Code, eksempelvis Terraform.
  • ser AI og automatisering som naturlige værktøjer og bidrager med idéer til, hvordan vi kan effektivisere arbejdsgange og skabe mere værdi på tværs af domænet.
  • har erfaring med programmering i Go.
  • har arbejdet med API’er, integrationer og distribuerede systemer.
  • tænker drift, automatisering, monitorering og observability som en naturlig del af softwareudvikling.
  • kan designe, udvikle og vedligeholde robuste softwareløsninger samt være med til at træffe tekniske beslutninger i teamet.

Det er meget relevant, hvis du har erfaring med streaming, video, broadcast eller mediedistribution.

Det kendetegner dig

De bedste løsninger skabes sammen. Derfor leder vi efter en kollega, der bidrager, er nysgerrig og byder engageret ind med idéer og forbedringer.

Vi forventer, at du:

  • tager tydeligt ejerskab for komplekse problemstillinger og får opgaver sikkert i mål.
  • er nysgerrig, udfordrende og konstruktiv i dialogen.
  • kommunikerer løbende om fremdrift, risici og afhængigheder.
  • er pragmatisk og kan balancere gode tekniske principper med virkelighedens behov.
  • opsøger feedback og bruger den til at udvikle dig.
  • deler viden og bidrager til teamets faglige og sociale fællesskab.
  • trives i samarbejdet på tværs af teams, domæner og fagligheder.
  • har erfaring med agile arbejdsmetoder og er vant til at nedbryde og estimere opgaver

Din rolle i organisationen

Som Software Engineer i Channel Assembly & Distribution bliver du en del af et produktteam med ansvar for både udvikling og drift.

Du omsætter strategi og tekniske principper til praksis, skaber transparens om tekniske valg og samarbejder på tværs af Live Production og TV 2 Teknologi.

Du skal ikke fastlægge retningen alene, men bidrage til fælles afklaring og støtte teamet i at nå velbegrundede beslutninger.

TV 2 som teknologiarbejdsplads

I TV 2s teknologiorganisation arbejder over 320 specialister hver dag med at udvikle hele den teknologiske værdikæde – fra avanceret medieteknologi og liveproduktion til digitale produkter som apps, streamingtjenester, dataløsninger og brugeroplevelser. Det er her, vi omsætter målet om personlig public service til konkrete løsninger, som møder danskernes behov på tværs af platforme.

Vi arbejder i tværfaglige teams – med bl.a. Software Engineers, UX‑designere, Enterprise Architects, konfigurationsspecialister og Data Scientists – og vi har fokus på kvalitet, tilgængelighed, performance og sikkerhed i alt, hvad vi bygger og driver. Du får kolleger i både Odense på Kvægtorvet og i København på Teglholmen samt en kultur, hvor læring, videndeling og ansvar går hånd i hånd med dynamikken i Danmarks største mediehus.

Søg jobbet

Send os dit CV med dine tidligere erfaringer og resultater samt en kort motivation for stillingen. Din arbejdsplads vil være i Odense. Ansøgningsfrist er den 8. november, hvorefter vi inviterer til samtaler.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig!

title: Contract Assistant Manager, Data Analytics
description:

Competitive base salary. A suite of holistic, flexible benefits to suit every lifestyle. Community initiatives. Industry-leading learning and professional development opportunities. Your wellbeing, growth and aspirations are every bit as cared for as the needs of our customers.

title: Grøn og passioneret Cater til Rudersdal Kommune
description:
I vores kantine har vi fokus på bæredygtighed, fællesskab, faglighed og velsmag. Lige nu søger vi dig, der brænder for at skabe grønne måltider med mening sammen med os.

Om jobbet

I Rådhuskantinerne laver vi mad til ca. 250 besøgende kolleger, der hver dag kommer og spiser hos os. Fra morgenstunden står vi klar med hjemmebagt morgenbrød og til frokost byder vi på lækre grønne retter. Derudover varetager vi mødeforplejning og andre større arrangementer som f.eks. receptioner og særlige begivenheder i kommunen.

Kernen i vores kantinekonceptet er enkelthed, kvalitet og variation – og vores mål er, at vi hver dag skaber måltider, der ikke bare mætter, men også inspirerer og begejstrer. Læs mere om vores kantine koncept her: KantineKoncept.pdf

Om dig

Du brænder for det grønne køkken og trives i et team hvor vi løfter i flok og hvor du byder ind med en god arbejdsmoral og et godt kollegaskab.

Derudover ser vi gerne at du;

  • Er uddannet inden for branchen, gerne som cater.
  • Har erfaring med plantebaseret mad og har lyst til at lære endnu mere.
  • Har smagspaletten i orden og sans for godt madhåndværk.
  • Har erfaring fra en mellemstor kantine og fra arbejdet som Cater.
Om Rådhuskantinerne

Rådhuskantinerne ligger på Rådhuset i Holte og i Administrationscenteret i Birkerød. Vi er i alt 8 medarbejdere. Vores hverdag er præget af faglig kollegial sparring, hyggelige rammer og en god stemning.

Om Rudersdal Kommune

I Rudersdal Kommune tror vi på, at vi kun lykkes i fællesskab. Derfor er det vores mål, at alle kommunens medarbejdere og ledere i alle opgaver - og i fællesskab - arbejder for at skabe bæredygtige løsninger, der giver værdi for borgerne, virksomheden og det samfund, vi er en del af. Se vores film om Rudersdal Kommunes strategi og værdier ”Vi lykkes kun i fællesskab” HER

Ansættelsesvilkår

Ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst og er på fuldtid

Forventet tiltrædelse den 1. marts 2027 – eller snarest muligt.

Ansøgning, samtale og kontakt

Intern kandidat haves.

Du søger jobbet ved at klikke på knappen "Søg stilling" nedenfor.

Samtaler: Vi forventer at holde samtaler den 17. og 19. november 2026

Har du spørgsmål? Kontakt Souschef Brian Milling-Hansen på mail brmi@rudersdal.dk

description:
Who We Are


Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.

Location:

Tainan,TWN

You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.

As a Systems Engineer, you’ll design, integrate, and optimize complex systems that drive the semiconductor industry forward. Your expertise in systems thinking and problem-solving is essential as you collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop advanced solutions to intricate processes and writing system specifications. You’ll be responsible for analyzing requirements, defining system architectures, conducting thorough testing, and ensuring seamless integration of subsystems. Additionally, you’ll identify and mitigate risks, confirming that our systems meet the highest quality standards and exceed customer expectations.

Key Responsibilities

  • System engineering: Serve as the system engineer in Taiwan, supporting system hardware bring-up, operation, and troubleshooting.
  • Part management: Manage Incoming/outgoing parts, including inventory, tracking and logistics.
  • Cross-site coordination: Coordinate activities and technical issues between multiple sites and drive issues to closure.
  • TMC technical POC: Serve as the team's technical point of contact with TMC (Taiwan Manufacturing Center), TRC (Taiwan refurb. Center) and Some Taiwan Suppliers.
  • Engineering tool maintenance: Responsible to maintain uptime of all Engineering team’s tools and test fixtures in Taiwan .
  • Part validation at TMC: Support validation of selected parts, including parts logistics and managements, understanding test requirements, test setup, troubleshooting, communication, execution, and reporting.
  • Field issue investigation: Investigate field hardware/electrical issues, and coordinate root-cause analysis and corrective actions across multiple teams and locations.

Required Skills and Education

  • BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechatronics, or related field.
  • 4-7 years of relevant engineering experience.
  • Strong electrical fundamentals in AC/DC power, controls, sensors, relays, protection, grounding, and analog/digital I/O.
  • Hands-on experience using DMMs, oscilloscopes, and other electrical test equipment.
  • Able to read, develop, and modify electrical schematics and wiring diagrams.
  • Experience with system integration, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and verification/testing.
  • Working knowledge of industrial communications such as Ethernet, RS-232/485, CAN, EtherCAT, Modbus, or DeviceNet.
  • Familiarity with PLC/I/O, motion control, interlocks, and safety circuits.
  • Understanding of electrical safety and equipment standards, with exposure to SEMI S2, NFPA 79, IEC 60204-1, CE, or UL preferred.
  • Semiconductor equipment experience preferred, particularly with vacuum, RF, gas delivery, thermal control, robotics/motion, or process equipment.
  • Strong technical documentation, communication, teamwork, and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong project management skills

Interpersonal Skills

  • Effective communicator in English and Mandarin; comfortable working with global teams across time zones.
  • Proactive, detail-oriented, and able to drive cross-site issues to closure independently.
  • Proficient in documenting procedures and writing reports in English.
  • Proficient in using Microsoft office.
