title: Stærkstrømsingeniør til udvikling af højspændingsstationer
description:
Vil du være med til at udvikle nogle af Danmarks vigtigste energianlæg?

Som stærkstrømsingeniør i Energinet får du en central rolle i etableringen af nye højspændingsstationer og udvidelsen af eksisterende anlæg på transmissionsnettet. Du arbejder med komplekse el-tekniske projekter og følger dem fra de første tekniske afklaringer til test, idriftsættelse og overdragelse.

Her får du mulighed for at sætte din faglighed i spil, udvikle de tekniske løsninger og bidrage til den fortsatte udbygning af et energisystem, der skal understøtte den grønne omstilling.

Du bliver en del af et erfarent fagligt miljø

Du bliver en del af afdelingen Instrumentering med base i Ballerup.

Vi er 23 specialister, som udvikler tekniske løsninger, der gør det muligt at overvåge, styre og beskytte transmissionsnettet. Samtidig bidrager vi til, at Danmark fortsat har en af verdens højeste forsyningssikkerheder og kan integrere stadig mere vedvarende energi i energisystemet.

Du indgår i et tværfagligt team med specialister inden for kontrol, beskyttelse og instrumentering. Sammen leverer vi automationsløsninger til store anlægsprojekter og sikrer høj kvalitet hele vejen fra design til idriftsættelse. Jobbet løses i en kombination mellem at være ”ude i marken” på vores højspændingstationer og på kontoret.

"Vi arbejder med tekniske løsninger, som har stor betydning for fremtidens energisystem. Hos os får du både faglige udfordringer, stor indflydelse på dit område og kolleger, der gerne deler deres viden."

Du følger projekterne fra design til idriftsættelse

Du arbejder både fra kontoret og ude på højspændingsstationerne, hvor du bidrager til, at de tekniske løsninger bliver leveret sikkert og i den rette kvalitet. Forvent at bruge mellem 30-50% af tiden på vores anlæg ude i landet.

Dine opgaver omfatter blandt andet at:

  • være specialist inden for styretavler, AC/DC-forsyningsanlæg, sikrings- og overvågningsløsninger
  • deltage i test af styretavler og egenforsyningsanlæg
  • konfigurere og teste styrings- og overvågningsløsninger
  • gennemføre tekniske afklaringer og samarbejde med leverandører og rådgivere
  • kvalitetssikre leverancer samt bidrage til standardisering og optimering af tekniske løsninger

Du har el-teknisk indsigt og interesse for komplekse anlæg

Du har en el-teknisk uddannelse som stærkstrømsingeniør, maskinmester, elinstallatør eller lignende.

Derudover ser vi gerne, at du:

  • har erfaring fra et forsyningsselskab, et rådgivende ingeniørfirma eller lignende
  • har erfaring med højspændingsanlæg eller andre komplekse el-tekniske anlæg
  • måske har en baggrund som elektriker
  • har nogle års relevant erhvervserfaring
  • taler og skriver dansk og engelsk på et højt niveau

Det vigtigste er, at du motiveres af el-tekniske opgaver og har lyst til at arbejde med komplekse anlæg og løsninger. Du arbejder struktureret og ansvarsbevidst, og du trives i samarbejdet med forskellige fagligheder. Samtidig tager du initiativ og bidrager gerne med idéer til udvikling, optimering og standardisering af både løsninger og processer.

Det er et krav, at du har kørekort B.

Vil du være med til at gøre en forskel sammen med os?

Så ser vi frem til at modtage dit motiverede cv senest den 15. november. Sæt allerede nu et par forsigtige kryds i kalenderen 19. november, hvor vi holder 1. samtale og 25. november, hvor vi holder 2. samtale – begge samtaler i Fredericia.

Har du spørgsmål til jobbet, er du velkommen til at kontakte afdelingsleder Kent B. Schødts på tlf. 24 79 66 26 eller gruppeleder Johnny Rusbjerg på tlf. 24 91 81 22.

Særlige forhold: Da Energinet løser samfundskritiske opgaver, udfører vi baggrundstjek forud for ansættelsen. Det er en forudsætning for ansættelse, at dit baggrundstjek er foreneligt med ansættelse i Energinet. Baggrundstjekket gennemføres desuden én gang årligt.

Jobbet kræver desuden, at du kan opnå og opretholde sikkerhedsgodkendelse. På PET's hjemmeside kan du læse mere om sikkerhedsgodkendelse.

Vi ser mangfoldighed som en styrke og opfordrer alle kvalificerede, uanset baggrund, til at søge jobbet. Vi arbejder aktivt og målrettet med mangfoldighed i Energinet og opfordrer dig derfor til at udelade billede, oplysninger om alder, civilstand og lignende, for at minimere ubevidste biases i processen. Du kan læse mere om vores mangfoldighedspolitik her.

Du bliver en del af Energinet Eltransmission A/S, der har til opgave at udvikle, bygge, eje og drive det nødvendige eltransmissionsnet, Herefter stilles det til rådighed for samfundet med den rette kapacitet, i den rette kvalitet, så omkostningseffektivt som muligt og således, at anlægget kan udnyttes optimalt og sikkert. Eltransmission sikrer optimal Asset Management ved at have fokus på anlæggenes samlede levetid - fra vugge til grav.

Glæd dig til at blive en del af en organisation med et meningsfuldt formål, hvor vi forsyner Danmark med el og gas, og omstiller energisystemet til grøn energi.

For at lykkes med den opgave, skal vi have dygtige og engagerede medarbejdere. Derfor har vi skabt rammer, hvor udvikling prioriteres, nye idéer bliver taget alvorligt, og der er balance mellem arbejde og privatliv. Vi kalder det Energi til mere, og du kan blive endnu klogere på det her

GUBI is seeking a proactive, highly organized, and service-minded Showroom Manager to oversee daily operations of GUBI House Copenhagen, the brand’s showroom in Nordhavn, delivering an exceptional visitor experience and maintaining the highest standards of presentation. As the first point of contact, you will welcome architects, interior designers, trade partners, private customers, and VIP guests, representing GUBI with professionalism, warmth, and a strong sense of hospitality. The showroom also serves as an important meeting point for GUBI colleagues and partners from around the world.

Key responsibilities

  • Take shared responsibility for the showroom activity plan, with a clear mandate to increase activity through new initiatives and unconventional thinking, helping establish the showroom as a high-activity commercial and brand hub that meets our ambitious targets.

  • Maintain exceptional showroom presentation and visual merchandising standards, with displays, furniture, and lighting reflecting GUBI’s brand identity and quality standards.
  • Coordinate showroom updates in line with new collections, product launches, and seasonal activities, working closely with internal teams.
  • Oversee the practical upkeep of the showroom, including cleaning, maintenance, and coordination with external suppliers and service providers.
  • oordinate showroom logistics in collaboration with the Warehouse team, including incoming and outgoing deliveries, furniture movements, samples, and office deliveries.
  • Maintain accurate records of showroom stock, samples, and inventory using relevant administrative systems.
  • Establish and maintain a showroom visitor and activity log, providing an overview of visitors and showroom usage.
  • Support the Sales and Marketing teams in planning and executing showroom events, activations, and client appointments.
  • Coordinate the practical setup, on-site logistics, and breakdown of showroom events, including moving and repositioning furniture and display items, to prepare the space for each occasion.

Qualifications

  • Previous experience in showroom management, premium retail, hospitality, or a similar customer-facing coordination role.
  • Experience maintaining high presentation standards in a showroom, retail, or hospitality environment.
  • Strong organizational skills and excellent attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities.
  • Experience coordinating activities and logistics across internal teams and external suppliers.
  • Confidence in using administrative systems and digital tools to manage stock, records, and daily operations.
  • Experience supporting events, client visits, or brand activations is an advantage.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a strong understanding of professional hospitality and customer service.
  • A background in furniture, interior design, or premium lifestyle brands is highly desirable.
  • Flexibility to work occasional evenings and weekends to support showroom events and activations.

Language skills

  • Professional fluency in English and Danish, both written and spoken.

Personal attributes

  • Structured and detail-oriented, with a strong sense of ownership.
  • Proactive and hands-on, comfortable working independently.
  • Service-minded and welcoming, with a natural ability to make guests feel valued and well looked after.
  • Professional and confident in representing GUBI to clients, partners, and visitors.
  • A strong communicator who collaborates easily across functions.
  • Calm and organized in a dynamic environment with changing daily priorities.
  • Resourceful and solution-oriented, with a practical approach to day-to-day challenges.
  • A genuine interest in design, furniture, and premium retail environments.

Job Description:

About the role


Mechanical Technicians execute preventative, corrective and breakdown maintenance across QGC Midstream mechanical equipment and systems.


The role supports safe, reliable and compliant operation of the LNG asset by completing high-quality maintenance, defect elimination, inspections, repairs, testing and equipment handovers in accordance with approved procedures, maintenance strategies and Control of Work requirements


Accountabilities


Safety, Health, Security, Environment & Process Safety

  • Work safely in accordance with Shell HSSE expectations, Life Saving Rules, Control of Work, Permit to Work, isolation and job hazard analysis requirements.
  • Demonstrate personal responsibility for safe work execution, intervention and stop-work authority.
  • Maintain housekeeping, tooling, lifting equipment and worksite standards.
  • Contribute to safe preparation and execution of shutdowns, campaigns and major maintenance events.

Mechanical Maintenance Execution

  • Execute preventive, corrective and predictive maintenance on mechanical equipment and systems.
  • Inspect, diagnose, repair, overhaul, test and return mechanical equipment to service in accordance with maintenance strategies, procedures and OEM requirements.
  • Support maintenance of pumps, compressors, valves, piping, pressure equipment, rotating equipment, static equipment, lifting equipment and associated mechanical systems as applicable to the asset.
  • Perform fault-finding and troubleshooting to minimise equipment downtime and improve reliability.
  • Support SCE, statutory and regulatory maintenance tasks as directed

Reliability, Quality and CMMS

  • Record as-found and as-left condition, failure information, work logs, materials usage and completion feedback in the CMMS.
  • Identify defects, recurring failures and improvement opportunities and escalate through appropriate maintenance and reliability processes.
  • Support defect elimination, bad actor reviews and continuous improvement activities. • Role model inclusive behaviours and contribute to a respectful team culture.
  • Ensure quality repairs and effective equipment handovers to Operations

Teamwork and Capability

  • Work collaboratively with Operations, E&I, Engineering, Planning, Contractors and OEM representatives.
  • Support apprentices, trainees and developing technicians through coaching and knowledge sharing.
  • Maintain required QGC, site, trade and competency requirements.
  • Role model inclusive behaviours and contribute to a respectful team culture.

Skills and Experience

  • Mechanical trade qualification.
  • Experience in industrial mechanical maintenance, preferably in LNG, oil and gas, petrochemical, utilities, mining, heavy industry or process plant environments.
  • Competence in mechanical planned maintenance, breakdown response, troubleshooting and quality repair execution.
  • Experience with Permit to Work systems, isolations, JHA/JSA and safe systems of work.
  • Ability to use CMMS systems to record maintenance history and work completion information.
  • Experience with rotating equipment, pressure systems, valves, compressors, pumps, flange management, lifting/rigging, statutory/SCE maintenance or LNG export facility operations.

Key Competencies

  • Personal Safety Leadership
  • Mechanical Maintenance Execution
  • Fault Finding
  • Quality Repair
  • CMMS Discipline
  • Reliability Mindset
  • Teamwork • Continuous Improvement


What we offer


You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You’ll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself.

  • Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together.
  • Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead.
  • Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices.
  • Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise.
  • Achieve your balance in a values-led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.
  • Benefit from flexible working hours, and the possibility of remote/mobile working.
  • Perform at your best with a competitive starting salary and annual performance-related salary increase – our pay and benefits packages are considered to be among the best in the world.
  • Take advantage of paid parental leave, including for non-birthing parents.
  • Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply.
  • Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and international teams.
  • Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes.

Shell in Australia

Shell has operated in Australia since 1901. From operating Australia’s first oil refinery, which was central to meeting Australia’s fuel needs, to fuelling the first Qantas commercial flight in the 1920s, to playing a foundation role in building some of Australia’s largest and most innovative natural resource developments.

Throughout this 125-year relationship the needs of our customers and the nation have changed and we have continued transforming our portfolio to meet these needs. Today, we are a leading natural gas producer and are playing our part in the transition to a low-carbon future by investing in the power sector, renewable energy sources and carbon abatement activities.

Shell has a significant Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG) business in Australia that makes a valuable contribution to today’s energy supply. This integrated gas portfolio includes our two Shell-operated gas production and liquefaction businesses, Shell QGC in Queensland and Prelude Floating LNG offshore in Western Australia, and our joint venture interests in Gorgon and North West Shelf in Western Australia and Arrow Energy in Queensland.


Today, Shell’s portfolio in Australia also includes zero- and low-carbon energy businesses such as commercial and industrial retailer, Shell Energy carbon farming specialist, Select Carbon the 120MW Gangarri solar development; residential energy retailer, Powershop Australia a 49% stake in WestWind Australia a 50% share of Kondinin Energy and several grid-scale Battery Energy Storage Solutions projects. title: Case Manager
description:
Position Title: Case Manager

Department: Case Management

Grade Range/Job Status: Full Time/Non-Exempt - Hourly

Reporting Relationship: Lead Case Manager

Supervisory Responsibilities: NA

Typical Schedule: Primarily M-F Days. Must occasionally be willing and able to work flexible hours/days, reflective of the dynamic schedule of the organization.


Position Summary


The Case Manager provides service coordination to individuals with various disabilities, needs, and backgrounds. The Case Manager is vital to helping people with disabilities and their families find their way through the social services system while promoting self-determination and a person-centered approach. Hammer Case Management provides services contracted with Hennepin County for people receiving disability services through CADI, BI, and DD programs. Individuals the case manager supports may live with mental health needs, physical health conditions, brain injuries, developmental disabilities, or neurodevelopmental disabilities. Many individuals supported by Hammer Case Managers have a combination of many needs and a variety of skills and preferences that make them unique and impact service planning. All employees are expected to center, model and champion Hammer’s core values: Person-Centered, Relational, Opportunistic and Stewardship in order to provide people with intellectual and other disabilities, the opportunity to live life to its fullest.


Primary Duties and Responsibilities


1. Service Coordination

  • Take person-centered approach to identify the needs and preferences of individuals on your caseload
  • Find resources to meet the unique needs of each individual
  • Complete referrals for services
  • Ensure services are not duplicated
  • Maintain regular contact with providers to ensure quality service delivery
  • Manage payment authorization for service providers

2. Support Plan Development and Maintenance

  • Identify goals, needs, and preferences of the individual
  • Develop annual support plan that integrates all necessary policy components
  • Update plan as necessary throughout the year

3. Advocacy

  • Promote health, safety, and well-being
  • Encourage independence and respect the right for individuals to take risks
  • Assist individuals in expressing their preferences and having their voice heard

4. In-person Home Visits

  • Maintain a minimum of two in-person visits annually with all individuals, either in their home or other community locations
  • Must be willing to drive throughout the greater Twin Cities and occasional travel throughout the state

5. Documentation

  • Document case notes in electronic record system
  • Maintain case notes for all work throughout the day
  • Must include a detailed, subjective narrative of all tasks completed
  • Include precise time of each completed task to allow for necessary billing of work
  • Ensure integrity in all documentation completed

Essential Knowledge and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in human services related field, required by DHS
  • Experience in disability services preferred
  • Experience working with mental health, preferred for CADI case management
  • Ability to demonstrate patience with individuals experiencing difficult circumstances
  • Must have a reliable vehicle and adequate driving record as this position requires travel to in-person visits at client homes
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Products (Word, Excel, Outlook)
  • Ability to maintain tracking systems for multiple tasks to meet varying deadlines
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with clients and other professionals
  • Flexibility to adapt to frequent process changes
  • Self-motivation to complete tasks independently
  • Willingness to ask questions
  • Experience, ability, and commitment to working with individuals and teams that are mixed across lines of difference such as race, gender-identity, sexual orientation, religion, ability, age, class, and immigrant status
  • Must be willing and able to work flexible hours/days, including occasional evenings and weekends, reflective of the dynamic schedule of the organization

This job description assigns essential functions. It does not restrict the tasks an individual in this position might be asked to perform or all qualifications that may be required currently or in the future.

title: HW Design Leader- Cisco Silicon One
description:
MEET THE TEAM

The Silicon One team creates innovative hardware platforms central to the AI era, powering Cisco’s core Switching, Routing, and Wireless products for organizations globally. Our innovations in silicon, optics, and hardware platforms are shaping the technology industry. We're a global team of creative experts, bringing our unique backgrounds and bold ideas to push boundaries and help each other grow. Because full product development—from design to qualification to production—is within our team, we're able to think differently, experiment more, and work quickly. Join us to power the future of the digital world!.

YOUR IMPACT

  • As the HW Design Leader, you will lead the board design team and PCB CAD engineers responsible for developing complex hardware platforms, including EVBs and test boards. You will guide designs from initial requirements through schematic capture, layout, lab bring-up, and manufacturing release, ensuring all programs meet technical, quality, and schedule goals.
  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of schematic designers and PCB CAD engineers across concurrent hardware programs.
  • Guide schematic design, board architecture, and power delivery in alignment with ASIC, package, and system specifications.
  • Manage PCB CAD engineers to oversee layout development, design constraints, and design rule compliance.
  • Lead cross-functional design reviews with Electrical, SI/PI, Mechanical, Thermal, Packaging, and Manufacturing teams.
  • Support prototype builds, board bring-up, lab debugging, and design handoffs to NPI and contract manufacturers.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering or a related field, with 8+ years of experience designing complex electronic boards or hardware platforms in an R&D environment.
  • Proven experience leading board design activities or mentoring a team of hardware design engineers.
  • Strong background in schematic design, board architecture, and hardware design reviews.
  • Experience working with PCB layout and CAD teams and understanding PCB design constraints.
  • Experience managing technical schedules, design deliverables, and cross-functional action items across engineering and manufacturing teams.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience developing EVBs, test boards, or networking, switching, routing, or server hardware.
  • Experience with high-speed digital designs, SerDes, Ethernet, PCIe, or DDR interfaces.
  • Familiarity with signal and power integrity, PCB stack-up definition, and design-for-manufacturing practices.
  • Experience with board bring-up, lab validation, and hardware debug.
  • Familiarity with PCB CAD tools such as Cadence Allegro and OrCAD.
  • Experience taking hardware designs from concept through qualification and production.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

En vigtig funktion i patienternes forløb

I Afdeling for Kræftbehandling arbejder vi med patientforløb inden for blandt andet prostata-, blære-, lunge-, tarm-, bryst-, bugspytkirtel- og livmoderkræft.

Som en del af vores sekretærgruppe får du en vigtig rolle i at få hverdagen og patientforløbene til at hænge sammen. Vores arbejde kræver overblik, struktur og et godt samarbejde med både patienter, pårørende, kolleger og klinikere.

En central del af din funktion bliver call-center funktionen. Her håndterer du patienternes henvendelser og hjælper med at sikre, at de får den rette hjælp, og at relevante spørgsmål og opgaver bliver fulgt op. Det kræver, at du kan kommunikere imødekommende, bevare overblikket og vurdere, hvornår en henvendelse skal gives videre til andre fagpersoner.

Derudover vil du varetage en række sundhedsadministrative opgaver inden for blandt andet booking, planlægning, koordinering og registrering.

En god mulighed for at udvikle dine kompetencer

Barselsvikariatet byder på en varieret hverdag med mange forskellige opgaver. Du får mulighed for at lære vores arbejdsgange, systemer og patientforløb at kende og gradvist blive mere sikker i de funktioner, du skal varetage.

Vi tilpasser introduktionen til dine erfaringer og kompetencer. Du behøver derfor ikke at kende vores speciale på forhånd, men du skal have lyst til at lære og udvikle dig i jobbet.

Stillingen kan være en god mulighed for dig, der er nyuddannet sundhedsadministrativ koordinator og gerne vil opbygge erfaring i praksis. Den kan også være relevant for dig med en anden sundhedsfaglig uddannelse, som har erfaring med sundhedsadministrative opgaver og ønsker at bringe dine kompetencer i spil i en ny sammenhæng.

Du vil ikke skulle varetage alle de mest komplekse sundhedsadministrative funktioner. Opgaverne tilpasses din uddannelse og erfaring, så du kan bidrage med det, du allerede kan, og udvikle dig inden for de funktioner, der hører til stillingen.

Hvem søger vi?

Vi søger først og fremmest dig, der er uddannet lægesekretær eller sundhedsadministrativ koordinator.

Har du en anden sundhedsfaglig uddannelse, kan du også komme i betragtning, hvis du har relevant erfaring med sundhedsadministrative opgaver og det rette mindset til at indgå i vores sekretærgruppe.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du:

  • arbejder struktureret og har blik for detaljerne
  • kan prioritere opgaver og bevare overblikket i en hverdag med forskellige henvendelser
  • kommunikerer imødekommende og professionelt med patienter, pårørende og kolleger
  • tager ansvar for dine opgaver og følger op på det, du sætter i gang
  • har lyst til at lære nye arbejdsgange og systemer at kende
  • bidrager positivt til samarbejdet og deler viden med dine kolleger.

En arbejdsplads med ro, retning og ordentlighed

Vi er en sekretærgruppe, hvor vi arbejder med at skabe tydelige arbejdsgange, dele viden og hjælpe hinanden i hverdagen.

Som leder lægger jeg vægt på, at du ved, hvad der forventes af dig, og at du får mulighed for at udvikle din faglighed. Jeg tror på, at vi lykkes bedst, når vi har tillid til hinanden, kommunikerer ordentligt og tager fælles ansvar for opgaverne og den arbejdsplads, vi er en del af.

Vi skal kunne spørge hinanden om hjælp, være nysgerrige og finde løsninger sammen. Vi behøver ikke at være ens, men vi skal kunne samarbejde om et fælles mål: at skabe gode og sammenhængende patientforløb.

Vi arbejder med alvorlige sygdomsforløb, men der skal også være plads til et smil og lidt lethed i hverdagen.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

Hos os får du:

  • en varieret sundhedsadministrativ stilling med en central rolle i call-center funktionen
  • mulighed for at udvikle dine kompetencer og få erfaring fra et specialiseret område
  • en introduktion, der tager udgangspunkt i din uddannelse og erfaring
  • kolleger, som du kan sparre med og lære af
  • en arbejdsplads, hvor faglighed, samarbejde og ordentlighed er vigtige værdier.

Praktiske oplysninger

Stillingsbetegnelse: Barselsvikariat i Afdeling for Kræftbehandling

Arbejdssted: SUH Køge

Arbejdstid: 37 timer om ugen

Tiltrædelse: snarest muligt

Vikariatets varighed: cirka 1 år

Ansøgningsfrist: 27. oktober 2026

Samtaler: forventes afholdt i uge 45

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig og til at møde en kollega, der har lyst til at bidrage til vores fællesskab og være med til at få hverdagen til at fungere – til gavn for både patienter og kolleger.

Ansættelsesområde

Region Sjælland og Region Hovedstaden bliver den 1. januar 2027 til Region Østdanmark som følge af sundhedsreformen. Dit ansættelsesområde vil være Region Østdanmark med alle tilhørende organisatoriske enheder.
Læs mere om betydningen af ansættelsesområdet på Region Østdanmarks hjemmeside.

Startløn for overenskomstansatte

Regionen er forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startlønnen for stillingen. Du får oplyst grundløn, centralt fastsatte tillæg og pension i den relevante overenskomst. Udover startlønnen, kan lønnen indeholde eventuelt forhandlede tillæg afhængigt af stillingen, dine erfaringer og kvalifikationer.
Se startlønnen på regionens hjemmeside

Om Sjællands Universitetshospital

Sjællands Universitetshospital er Danmarks nyeste universitetshospital med aktiviteter i Køge, Roskilde og Nykøbing F. Vi er et modigt og udadvendt universitetshospital, hvor vi hver dag arbejder for at skabe et sammenhængende sundhedsvæsen og større lighed i sundhed for borgerne i regionen.

Vores optageområde er præget af flere borgere med kronisk sygdom og sociale udfordringer end landsgennemsnittet. Derfor arbejder vi målrettet med innovation, nye samarbejdsformer og løsninger, der bringer behandling tættere på borgerne.

Hos os bliver du en del af en ambitiøs arbejdsplads, hvor samarbejde på tværs, høj faglighed og løbende forbedringer er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Vores ledelsesværdier er nytænkning, følgeskab, ordentlighed og fællesskab, og de sætter retning for, hvordan vi arbejder, udvikler os og skaber gode resultater – for både borgere og medarbejdere.

location: Everstory Partners Support Center - Altamonte Springs, FL
description:
Please note: This will be a fully onsite role, Monday through Friday, at our Support Center office in the Altamonte Springs, FL area (Greater Orlando).


Why Everstory


At Everstory Partners, our mission is to create supportive spaces where individuals and families can find solace, meaning, and hope in the midst of loss. At the heart of our mission is a deep understanding of the profound and complex nature of grief. Every person’s journey through loss is unique, and we are committed to providing compassionate and personalized support.


We also believe that grief is not a problem to be solved or a burden to manage alone, but rather a natural and beautiful part of the human experience. Backed by our national strength and our local partners’ role is to be a steady presence, a source of comfort and guidance, and a partner in celebrating the life and legacy of the person who has passed.


The Impact You Will Make


The Digital Experience & E-commerce Manager oversees the management, performance, and continuous improvement of Everstory Partners’ websites and digital customer experience. This role is responsible for optimizing website functionality, improving customer engagement and lead generation, and developing e-commerce capabilities to drive conversion rates and online revenue growth. Working collaboratively with Marketing, Data Analytics, Sales, Operations, IT, and external partners, the manager leads digital initiatives, coordinates website enhancements, and leverages analytics and emerging technologies to improve operational efficiency, customer experience, and overall business performance.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities


Website Management & E-commerce

  • Oversee the day-to-day management, maintenance, and continuous improvement of Everstory Partners’ websites, ensuring accurate content, imagery, pricing, and product/service information.
  • Optimize website navigation, mobile usability, landing pages, and inquiry forms to improve the customer experience, lead generation, and conversion rates.
  • Lead the planning and implementation of e-commerce capabilities, including product/service listings, online purchasing, order processing, and tracking.
  • Manage digital merchandising, pricing visibility, and checkout experiences to improve online transactions and revenue.
  • Partner with Sales, Operations, IT, and agency partners to coordinate website enhancements and align e-commerce functionality with business requirements.

Digital Marketing & Customer Experience

  • Coordinate social media, email, paid search, and digital advertising initiatives to support website traffic, qualified lead generation, and revenue growth.
  • Guide SEO, digital content, and online reputation initiatives in collaboration with internal teams and agency partners.
  • Optimize the digital customer journey from initial website engagement through lead capture, online purchasing, and CRM interactions.
  • Collaborate with the Marketing Systems Specialist to support CRM integration, lead routing, and automated customer communications.
  • Evaluate and implement approved AI-enabled tools to enhance digital content, personalization, marketing efficiency, and customer experience.

Strategy, Analytics & Performance

  • Develop and maintain a prioritized roadmap for website and e-commerce enhancements aligned with Marketing strategy and organizational objectives.
  • Define business requirements, project deliverables, and success measures for digital initiatives, including new locations and acquisition transitions.
  • Monitor website and campaign performance, including traffic, qualified leads, appointments, conversion rates, online transactions, and attributed revenue.
  • Use analytics, customer feedback, and testing to identify improvement opportunities and recommend strategies that support business growth.
  • Evaluate digital platforms and vendors, oversee agency deliverables, and coordinate implementation with internal stakeholders.
  • Partner with Data Analytics and Finance on performance reporting while ensuring agency accountability, website quality, and timely issue resolution.

description:
• Lead complex managed funds transactions from appointment through to successful onboarding
  • Work closely with clients, legal advisers, investment managers and senior internal stakeholders
  • Apply deep managed funds expertise across Responsible Entity, Trustee and Custody services

Perpetual Group is an ASX-listed company (ASX:PPT) headquartered in Sydney, Australia, consisting of 11 leading brands across three distinct businesses: Asset Management, Wealth Management and Corporate Trust.

Perpetual Corporate Trust (PCT), a specialist business within the Perpetual Group, is a leading fiduciary, custody and digital business in Australia, with operations in Singapore. We provide a unique range of products to help clients, and the industry, be more effective, efficient and economical while managing ever-increasing cyber security risks and maintaining compliance. Domestic and global financial institutions leverage our corporate strength, commercial approach, risk and compliance practices, expertise and service excellence in debt markets, managed funds and digital solutions to enable our clients success.

About the Role

This is an exciting opportunity to become part of the Managed Fund Services Onboarding team within Perpetual Corporate Trust (PCT).

Join PCT in a senior transaction management role focused on delivering a seamless experience for new Managed Fund Services clients. As Senior Transaction Manager, you’ll manage new Managed Fund Services appointments end to end across Responsible Entity, Wholesale Trustee and Custody product lines. You’ll coordinate clients, lawyers, investment managers, service providers and internal teams to progress transactions from initial fee mandate through documentation, approval, operational setup and handover.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Lead the onboarding of new clients, including the establishment of registered schemes and unregistered trusts
  • Manage the negotiation and execution of contractual documentation and associated approval processes
  • Coordinate the review and approval of disclosure documents including PDSs, Information Memorandums and TMDs
  • Build effective relationships with clients, lawyers, investment managers, service providers and internal stakeholders
  • Oversee operational setup and ensure new appointments are handed over effectively to client management teams
  • Apply current regulatory knowledge to help protect Perpetual while supporting an efficient client experience
  • Support business development, continuous improvement and cross team collaboration to win and successfully onboard new business.

About you

  • Tertiary qualifications in Business, Accounting, Economics or Law
  • You bring substantial financial services experience and a strong understanding of the legal, regulatory and operational requirements involved in managed investment schemes
  • At least 10 years’ experience in financial services, including at least two years in onboarding or a similar role
  • Strong experience reviewing and negotiating legal and contractual documentation for retail and wholesale schemes
  • Detailed knowledge of regulations governing registered and unregistered managed investment schemes
  • Strong stakeholder management, negotiation, presentation and relationship management skills
  • Excellent time management skills and the ability to manage complex transactions across multiple parties
  • An understanding of Responsible Entity, Trustee and Custody functions across regulatory, contractual and operational requirements
  • Leadership capability, with the ability to lead teams where required and collaborate across functions.

We love hearing from people who are inspired to shape the future with us. If you're excited about this opportunity or about joining Perpetual Corporate Trust, we encourage you to apply.


How we work

Our unique culture is underpinned by our three organisational behaviours, Stretch, Own it, Make an impact which drive our approach of day-to-day interactions with colleagues and clients, the way we approach decision-making to the questions we ask and the problems we solve. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace where diversity is celebrated. No matter your background or circumstances, we aim to provide an environment where you can thrive.

  • Work from anywhere in Australia for up to one month each year
  • An annual allowance to empower you to prioritise your personal wellbeing
  • Study support and commitment to supporting professional development.

  • Advanced emergency and critical care nursing knowledge and skills
  • Strong understanding of pharmacology, medication protocols, calculations, dosing, and safe medication handling

  • Advanced understanding of diagnostics and collaboration with veterinarians regarding patient care plans

  • Experience supporting critical patient care and triage

  • Ability to manage multiple schedules, trainees, projects, and training records simultaneously
  • Ability to frequently bend, stand, stoop, walk, sit, talk, listen, and work in physically demanding positions
  • Ability to frequently lift and/or move up to 50 pounds and occasionally assist with patients weighing over 150 pounds
  • A Credentialed VTS in Emergency and Critical Care with an active license (preferred)
  • Prior experience training, precepting, or leading clinical staff (strongly preferred)

Our team is built on a shared commitment to patient care, collaboration, and continuous learning. title: Senior/Principal Mechanical Technologist - Aerosol Science, Onsite
description:
About Sandia

Sandia National Laboratories is the nation’s premier science and engineering lab for national security and technology innovation, with teams of specialists focused on cutting-edge work in a broad array of areas. Some of the main reasons we love our jobs:

  • Challenging work with amazing impact that contributes to security, peace, and freedom worldwide
  • Extraordinary co-workers
  • Some of the best tools, equipment, and research facilities in the world
  • Career advancement and enrichment opportunities
  • Flexible work arrangements for many positions include 9/80 (work 80 hours every two weeks, with every other Friday off) and 4/10 (work 4 ten-hour days each week) compressed workweeks, part-time work, and telecommuting (a mix of onsite work and working from home)
  • Generous vacation, strong medical and other benefits, competitive 401k, learning opportunities, relocation assistance and amenities aimed at creating a solid work/life balance*

World-changing technologies. Life-changing careers. Learn more about Sandia at: http://www.sandia.gov


*These benefits vary by job classification.

What Your Job Will Be Like

Org. 6633 is seeking a skilled Mechanical Technologist to advance critical Research and Development (R&D) efforts focused on the characterization, mitigation, and neutralization of aerosolized weapons of mass destruction (WMD) threats. The ideal candidate will support activities in laboratory and/or field environments, transforming innovative concepts into operational solutions. In this hands-on role, you will operate and maintain experimental equipment, conduct complex experiments, ensure laboratory safety, and meticulously document findings. With minimal supervision, you will execute diverse technical procedures that drive mission success and safeguard national security.

On any given day, you may be called on to:
  • Conduct aerosol, filtration, chemical, optical, or physical experiments to assist scientists and engineers in the performance of R&D, and perform qualitative and quantitative analyses for work involving experimental, theoretical, or practical applications of science or technology.
  • Work collaboratively with other technologists, students, postdoctoral appointees, and staff members on the team and to serve as a resource to further the technical capabilities in the department.
  • Develop new experimental processes, primarily in aerosol, filtration, and particle-laden flow sciences, utilize analytical techniques, establish new characterization methods, perform experiments, and optimize existing laboratory processes and characterization techniques.
  • Perform work in a safe and compliant manner, seek out domain expert advice as needed, and maintain necessary laboratory, safety, and procedural documentation.
  • Serve as a laboratory owner, maintaining operational capabilities and ensure all safety documentation and processes are current and followed by all members of the team.
  • Develop, build, modify, repair, or maintain a wide variety of laboratory apparatus and equipment, interface this equipment for data acquisition, and maintain the laboratory space they reside in.
  • Develop and maintain material and process specifications to support engineering and scientific processes and work with key suppliers.
  • Perform data analysis and interpretation, statistical error analysis, materials characterization, and information extraction, and formally document results for customers and stakeholders.
  • Support documentation and publication efforts, including the preparation of information for scientific and engineering publications.

Due to the nature of this work the slected applicant must be able to work onsite.

Salary Range

$74,700 - $144,400

*Salary range is estimated, and actual salary will be determined after consideration of the selected candidate's experience and qualifications, and application of any approved geographic salary differential.

Qualifications We Require

  • Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, electrical engineering, chemistry, physics or a STEM discipline.
  • Demonstrated laboratory experience (i.e. experiment design, instrumentation setup, testing, monitoring/troubleshooting, detector calibrations, and data analysis)
  • Experience with mechanical design principals and tools
  • Ability to obtain a Q clearance

Qualifications We Desire

  • Possess an understanding of the scientific method and experimental procedures.
  • Excellent communications skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to constructively work with teams to successfully execute complex projects.
  • Skill and knowledge in one or more areas of: aerosol science, particle-laden flows, microscopy, nanoparticles and microparticles, filtration, fluid mechanics, engineering, physics, materials science, and chemistry.
  • Ability to write operating procedures, safety documentation, methods of analysis, and laboratory procedures.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal guidance, as well as collaboratively as part of a team.
  • Willingness to participate in field tests and experiments.
  • Ability to apply analytical and computer skills.
  • Experience with radiological safety and handling.
  • Ability to interface equipment to data acquisition systems.
  • Ability to write algorithms for test automation and acquisition systems.
  • Knowledge of utilization of instrumentation to measure and observe physical phenomena and effects.
  • Ability to develop expert knowledge of laboratory equipment and processes to enable adjustment when necessary and to recognize when equipment malfunctions.
  • Ability to conceptualize and communicate major elements of experimental design and results and to represent to other staff, management, and visitors, the scientific and engineering principles being investigated or developed.
  • Experience and demonstrated skill in conducting research, investigating anomalies and alternative solutions, and recommending solutions to problems.
  • Interest and/or experience mentoring student interns.

About Our Team

We are a diverse team of scientists and engineers that research, analyze, develop, and deliver technical solutions to predict, detect, identify, defeat, decontaminate, and mitigate threats posed by chemical, biological, radiological, and nuclear (CBRN) agents. Some examples include: chemical/biological agent mitigation and neutralization, dispersal device characterization, deployable onsite analysis of biological threats, threat containment, decontamination methodology testing, and atmospheric science applications.

Posting Duration

This posting will be open for application submissions for a minimum of three (3) calendar days, including the 'posting date'. Sandia reserves the right to extend the posting date at any time.

Security Clearance

Sandia is required by DOE to conduct a pre-employment drug test and background review that includes checks of personal references, credit, law enforcement records, and employment/education verifications. Applicants for employment need to be able to obtain and maintain a DOE Q-level security clearance, which requires U.S. citizenship. If you hold more than one citizenship (i.e., of the U.S. and another country), your ability to obtain a security clearance may be impacted.

Applicants offered employment with Sandia are subject to a federal background investigation to meet the requirements for access to classified information or matter if the duties of the position require a DOE security clearance. Substance abuse or illegal drug use, falsification of information, criminal activity, serious misconduct or other indicators of untrustworthiness can cause a clearance to be denied or terminated by DOE, resulting in the inability to perform the duties assigned and subsequent termination of employment.

EEO

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status and any other protected class under state or federal law.

NNSA Requirements for MedPEDs

If you have a Medical Portable Electronic Device (MedPED), such as a pacemaker, defibrillator, drug-releasing pump, hearing aids, or diagnostic equipment and other equipment for measuring, monitoring, and recording body functions such as heartbeat and brain waves, if employed by Sandia National Laboratories you may be required to comply with NNSA security requirements for MedPEDs.

If you have a MedPED and you are selected for an on-site interview at Sandia National Laboratories, there may be additional steps necessary to ensure compliance with NNSA security requirements prior to the interview date.

Essential Functions

If offered the position, you may be required to demonstrate your fitness to perform certain physical aspects of the position, including lifting, carrying, pushing, and pulling.

Job Purpose:

· The Senior Product Owner (GLAMS) is responsible for maximising the value of Artwork & Packaging products by translating business priorities and operational opportunities into measurable product outcomes, a prioritised backlog and controlled delivery across the product lifecycle. Working within the strategic, financial, architectural and risk guardrails set by the Associate Director - Tech Product Owner (GLAMS) and Product Domain Lead, the role ensures solutions are usable, secure, compliant, supportable and aligned to product strategy.

· The Senior Product Owner (GLAMS) guides Product Analysts and works with Engineers, Architects, Testers, Service teams and external partners to move priority opportunities from discovery through PoC, PoV or MVP validation where appropriate, and into scalable product delivery. The job holder makes day-to-day backlog and acceptance decisions, uses evidence to recommend continue, adapt or stop choices, and applies product performance information to improve adoption, stability, user experience and operational readiness.

· The role is accountable for maintaining clarity of scope, value and decision making throughout discovery, refinement, design, validation, testing, release and operation. It embeds Responsible AI, cybersecurity, data governance, privacy, GxP, architecture and service requirements from the start, and ensures validated solutions transition into sustainable product, supplier and support ownership. Strategic investment, major architecture and cross-product trade-offs are escalated to the Associate Director - Tech Product Owner (GLAMS) or Product Domain Lead in line with agreed decision rights.

Key Responsibilities:

· Partner with Artwork & Packaging stakeholders, users and technology teams to identify high-value operational opportunities and define measurable product outcomes within the strategy and guardrails set by the Associate Director - Tech Product Owner (GLAMS) and Product Domain Lead.

· Own and prioritise the product backlog, ensuring epics, features and user stories are supported by evidence on user value, process impact, cost, risk, dependencies, adoption potential and scalability, with clear and testable acceptance criteria.

· Lead structured discovery and, where appropriate, rapid PoC, PoV and MVP validation with Product Analysts, Engineers and business users, using real workflows and data to test value, feasibility and governance assumptions before committing to scale.

· Make evidence-based continue, adapt or stop recommendations and day-to-day scope, backlog and acceptance decisions within delegated authority, escalating investment, architecture and cross-product trade-offs through the agreed governance model.

· Lead iterative product delivery across refinement, design, build, testing, validation, demonstrations and release, ensuring traceability from business outcomes through requirements, controls and delivered capability.

· Ensure Responsible AI, cybersecurity, privacy, data governance, GxP, architecture, quality, change and service requirements are incorporated from discovery and that specialist approvals and validation evidence are obtained when required.

· Coordinate software vendors and cross-functional delivery teams, holding partners accountable for quality, documentation, knowledge transfer, delivery commitments, service performance and achievement of agreed business and operational outcomes.

title: Financial Coordinator
description:
The Financial Coordinator plays a critical role in managing the financial aspects of student admissions and registrations. They are responsible for collecting tuition fees, processing payments, and ensuring compliance with financial policies and regulations.

Key Responsibilities:

1-Collecting tuition fees and other charges from students during the admission and registration process.
2-Verifying student financial records and ensuring the accuracy of payment details and transaction information.
3-Assisting students and their families with understanding tuition fees, payment deadlines, and available payment options.
4-Processing payments using electronic payment systems, cash, checks, or other forms of payment, ensuring accuracy and completeness.
5-Recording all financial transactions accurately in the student information system or database and maintaining up-to-date records.
6-Generating and issuing receipts, invoices, and payment reminders to students for their tuition fees and other charges.
7-Resolving any payment discrepancies or issues promptly and effectively, liaising with students, parents, or guardians as needed.
8-Collaborating with other departments, such as the admissions office and financial aid office, to coordinate payment processes and address student inquiries.
9-Monitoring outstanding balances and following up with students who have overdue payments to ensure timely collections.
10-Adhering to all relevant policies, procedures, and regulations related to financial transactions, confidentiality, and data security.
11-Contacting debtors via phone, email, or mail to negotiate payment plans and collect overdue debts.
12-Explaining debt repayment options and providing assistance to debtors in understanding their financial obligations.
13-Documenting all communication with debtors and updating the company's database with accurate and up-to-date information.
14-Following up on missed payments and implementing appropriate collection actions, such as sending reminder notices or initiating legal proceedings.
15-Resolving disputes or complaints from debtors and addressing any issues that may arise during the collection process.
16-Providing regular reports to management on debt collection activities, including progress, challenges, and potential risks.


Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, business administration, or a related field is preferred.
  • Proven experience in a similar role, preferably in an educational institution or financial services environment or account receivable.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact professionally with students, parents, and colleagues.
  • Proficiency in using computer software and databases for processing payments and maintaining financial records.
  • Attention to detail and accuracy in handling financial transactions and maintaining records.
  • Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Knowledge of practices related to student financial services and collections.
  • Customer service-oriented mindset with a commitment to providing exceptional service to students and their families.

title: Senior AI Engineer (Full-Stack)
description:
**Build full-stack AI agents for science, with freedom, room to be creative, and real ownership, in a lively startup in Copenhagen.

**An AI agent is only as useful to a scientist as the data it can see and trust. Dalea gives research labs structured data with full provenance, and we want AI co-scientists that do real scientific work on top of it. You'll own the AI side of that.

What you'll own

  • The agent harness and the framework for AI co-scientist agents, from architecture to the workflows they run.
  • Our MCP integrations, which give agents access to lab data with a traceable record of what they do.
  • Model choices: following the field, testing new models against what labs actually need, and adopting what works.
  • How we evaluate AI quality.
  • The infrastructure the AI runs on: inference, model serving and agent execution.
  • Full-stack work wherever the AI needs deeper integration with the platform, and help elsewhere when the team needs it.

What you bring

**Must-haves

**

  • You've designed and built an LLM agent system used in production, and made the architecture decisions yourself.
  • Strong full-stack TypeScript (React, Next.js or close equivalents), and you're comfortable in Python.
  • You've owned the direction of a technical area, including a significant rework.
  • You've shipped quickly in a small team or an early-stage product.

**Nice To Have (none Of Them Required)

**

  • MCP servers or clients, agent frameworks or harness tooling (open source counts)
  • Tools for scientists, or a background in bioinformatics, computational biology or AI for science
  • Mastra or another TypeScript agent framework
  • Open-weight models, through inference APIs or self-hosting
  • Kubernetes
  • Systems where provenance or audit trails matter

You don't need lab or biology knowledge, a PhD or Danish. Hands-on, shipped work counts more than research or publications. If you match the must-haves, apply, even if you have none of the nice-to-haves.

Our stack

TypeScript, Next.js and React. Python for our MCP service. An agent harness built on Mastra. Docker Compose and Kubernetes, hosted on Scaleway.

How we work

Our dev team is the two founders plus up to three new developers, led by our CTO. We discuss progress and priorities closely and continuously, and we expect you to take part: share ideas early, argue for what you think is right, and change course when the evidence says so.

You won't need permission to fix what's broken, and what you build reaches production quickly. We work together at BioInnovation Institute 3–5 days a week. We're building the team and the way we work, and that happens best in person.

**About Dalea

**Dalea is a data management platform for biology and lab workflows. Experiments, structured data, samples and inventory sit in one place, with full data provenance. Everything a lab builds in Dalea can be packaged and shared, so we're building a GitHub for life science: labs publish and reuse each other's workflows instead of rebuilding them from scratch. We work with biotech startups, academic labs, pharma R&D and CROs.

Timing and our funding round

This position depends on our current funding round closing, which we expect in February/March 2027. We can make a conditional offer before then, and we'll be open with you about the timing throughout the process.

What we offer

  • Salary: DKK 725,000–900,000 per year, depending on experience
  • Warrants: under the Danish
  • 7P scheme
  • Pension: through ASE
  • Location: BioInnovation Institute, Copenhagen, on-site 3–5 days a week. You'll need to live in the Copenhagen area or be willing to move here. We're happy to hear from people relocating within the EU.
  • Language: English
  • Start: when the round closes

How to apply

Apply here with your LinkedIn profile, your CV and short answers to a few questions. No cover letter needed.

We're also hiring a Senior AI Engineer. You're welcome to apply for more than one.

  • Demonstrate strong commercial awareness, with experience managing budgets, financial performance and operational targets.
  • Have a good understanding of HR processes, including recruitment, performance management, training and employee development.
  • Possess excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with clients and key stakeholders.
  • Be proactive, adaptable and solutions-focused, with excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities.

Rapport Guest Services is a multi-award-winning company, delivering front- and back-of-house guest services for leading organisations across the UK, Ireland, and globally. As part of Compass Group UK&I, we combine people-first culture with exceptional service standards.

title: Trainee i revision (Odense)
description:
Trainee i Aiders revisionsafdeling

Du er stærk til tal og god med mennesker. Nu mangler du bare det rette sted at starte.

At starte som trainee er en kæmpe milepæl i din karriere, og hos Aider er vores vigtigste opgave at give dig den mest trygge, lærerige og sjove start som muligt. Du får en fast kontrakt, betalt HD-uddannelse og rigtige arbejdsopgaver fra begyndelsen - altid med den rette støtte i ryggen.

Ingen forventer, at du er eksperten fra dag ét. Vi leder efter dig, der har drivet og nysgerrigheden til at suge viden til dig. Du bliver del af et engageret trainee-hold, der følges ad gennem uddannelsen, og din egen buddy står klar til at hjælpe dig godt til rette i hverdagen.

Hvem er vi?

Aider er et kompetencehus med rådgivning inden for revision, skat, Corporate Finance og outsourcing. Vi har en flad struktur og korte beslutningsveje, og vi arbejder på tværs af fagligheder og kontorer. Hos os handler det om relationer, både internt og med kunderne, og vi tror på, at de bedste løsninger opstår, når man sparrer med hinanden og har tillid til hinanden. Vi gør, hvad vi siger, og der er plads til både ansvar, udvikling og balance.

Hvad kommer du til at lave?

Som trainee hos Aider får du en alsidig hverdag, hvor du hurtigt omsætter din viden fra HD-studiet til praksis. Vi arbejder tæt på erhvervslivet og rådgiver mindre og mellemstore virksomheder (SMV'er) i mange forskellige brancher.

Din hverdag bliver en god blanding af at:

  • Dykke ned i tal, udarbejde regnskaber og kvalitetssikre revisionen i samarbejde med dit team.
  • Deltage aktivt på kundebesøg, deltage i opstartsmøder og medvirke ved fysiske lageroptællinger ude i virkeligheden.
  • Udforske nye måder at rådgive på ved hjælp af smarte AI-værktøjer og datadrevne analyser.
  • Løbende forventningsafstemme og kommunikere med kunderne i hverdagen.

Du får ansvar fra start, men du løber aldrig alene. Du bliver en vigtig del af teams, hvor der altid er erfarne kolleger tæt på dig, som brænder for at lære fra sig.

Job og studie går hånd i hånd

Du starter sammen med andre trainees, der ligesom dig skal læres op fra bunden. Stillingen er på fuldtid, og ved siden af læser du HD på aftenskole sammen med de andre trainees. Du får desuden en buddy, der ved, hvordan det er at være ny og hjælper dig med opgaver og systemer og tager dig med ind i det sociale.

Det får du som trainee hos Aider

  • Fuldtidskontrakt uden udløbsdato – med udbetalt eller afspadseret overarbejde.
  • 4-dages arbejdsuge i lavsæsonen, så du får ekstra overskud i hverdagen til studiet, eksamensforberedelse eller dine fritidsinteresser.
  • Betalt HD-uddannelse samt en dedikeret pulje betalte timer til undervisning og læsning.
  • Løbende 1:1-samtaler med din nærmeste leder, hvor der er fuldt fokus på din faglige udvikling, trivsel og retning.
  • En personlig buddy, der støtter dig i hverdagen, giver faglig feedback og hjælper dig trygt i gang i dit eget tempo.
  • Grundige introdage og lærerig intern undervisning.

Du behøver ikke have erfaring, det står vi for

Du skal som minimum have en gymnasial uddannelse (HHX, STX eller lignende), der giver adgang til HD-uddannelsen.

Derudover ser vi gerne, at du:

  • Brænder for at udvikle dig inden for revision.
  • Har sat dig ind i branchen og er klar til at komme i gang.
  • Har tænkt over, hvordan det er at have fuldtidsarbejde og aftenskole på samme tid.
  • Har sans for tal og analyse og kan Excel.
  • Har lyst til at være en del af et fællesskab.

Sådan søger du

I stedet for en traditionel ansøgning svarer du på tre spørgsmål via "Søg stillingen" og vedhæfter dit CV samt dit seneste karakterbevis. Begge dele skal med, for at vi kan tage din ansøgning i betragtning. Som en ekstra ting kan du også vedhæfte en kort video på 30 sekunder, hvor du fortæller lidt om dig selv, men dette er ikke et krav.

Vi indkalder til samtaler løbende, så vær gerne tålmodig – interessen er stor. Bliver du ikke indkaldt, får du et skriftligt afslag.

Studiestart er i september, og din officielle opstart hos os er den 1. oktober 2027.

Inden opstart samler vi hele traineeholdet til et par hyggelige introaftener, så I kan lære hinanden at kende, allerede før I starter.

Spørgsmål?

Har du spørgsmål, kan du kontakte Talent Acquisition Specialist, Nikoline Stefansen, på tlf.: 81 88 81 90 eller mail nst@aider.dk.

I Aider tror vi på, at mangfoldighed styrker både fællesskabet og kvaliteten af vores arbejde. Vi opfordrer derfor alle kvalificerede – uanset køn, alder, etnisk baggrund, religion, seksuel orientering eller handicap – til at søge stillingen.

title: Office Administrator
description:
Full-Time Office Administrator | $21.00 per Hour

Knupp Farms Inc. | Washington, Iowa

Pay: $21.00 per hour, paid weekly
Schedule: Full-time, Monday – Friday, with a paid lunch hour
Benefits: Group health insurance, PTO, and 8 paid holidays

Location: On-site in Washington, Iowa


Join Our Team!

Looking for steady weekday hours, no nights or weekends, and an office where your work actually matters? We’re looking for a detail-oriented and dependable Office Administrator to join our office team. If you’re an organized team player who likes keeping information accurate and easy to find, this opportunity is for you!


About Us

Knupp Farms Inc. is a family-run agricultural and livestock hauling company that has been based in Washington, Iowa for more than 45 years. Our office keeps the farming and trucking sides of the business running: tracking loads, paperwork, invoices, and records so our drivers and farm team can focus on their work. You’ll be a key part of a small office team where people know your name.


Why You’ll Love This Role

As the Data Entry & Administrative Assistant, you’ll:

  • Enter, update, and maintain data in Microsoft Excel and company systems
  • Review information for accuracy and completeness, and follow up to correct errors
  • Keep electronic and paper records organized for our farming and transportation operations
  • Help with invoices, reports, and routine office paperwork
  • Support recordkeeping and tracking for daily business operations
  • Help with social media posts and updates, if that’s something you enjoy
  • Take on other administrative tasks and projects as needed, while keeping company information confidential

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including sorting, filtering, and basic formulas
  • QuickBooks experience
  • Comfortable with the Microsoft Office Suite, including Word and Outlook
  • Excellent attention to detail and accuracy
  • Organized, with good time management
  • Able to work independently and prioritize your workload
  • Good communication skills and comfortable working with office staff, drivers, and farm team members
  • Reliable attendance and punctuality
  • Previous data entry or administrative experience required
  • Social media experience is a plus!

Why You’ll Love Working at Knupp Farms Inc.

We believe in taking care of our team:

  • Weekly Pay: Paid every Tuesday.
  • Health Coverage: Group health insurance, with eligibility beginning the 1st of the month after 60 days of employment.
  • Paid Lunch: A paid one-hour lunch break every day.
  • Time to Recharge: 24 hours of PTO at 6 months and 40 hours at 1 year, growing to 112 hours per year at 5+ years. Use it in 1-hour increments, and unused PTO is paid out at your anniversary instead of being lost.
  • Paid Holidays: 8 paid company holidays, including both Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve.
  • Work-Life Balance: Monday through Friday office hours. No nights, no weekends.
  • Family-Run Culture: Join a small, close-knit team that values reliability and teamwork.
  • Variety: No two days look exactly the same across our farming and transportation operations.

Competitive Compensation That Rewards Your Experience

At Knupp Farms Inc., we value the skills and experience you bring to our team, and we believe your pay should reflect that.

  • Starting Pay Range: $21.00 per hour, based on experience and qualifications
  • Performance-Based Growth: After your introductory period, you’ll receive a performance review with the opportunity for a pay increase.

Ready to Take the Next Step in Your Career?

Join us in keeping the information behind our farming and transportation operations accurate and organized.

Dine primære opgaver bliver:

  • Lyddesign på alle vores egenproduktioner
  • Systemdesign, ophæng og programmering af lyd til teatrets forestillinger samt eventuelle co-produktioner
  • Komposition og design af øvrigt lydmateriale til egenproduktioner efter behov
  • Periodevis afvikling af forestillinger i rotation med teatrets øvrige personale
  • Indkøb og vedligehold af teknisk udstyr inkl. indretning og organisering af lydværksted
  • Detaljeret planlægning af scenetid i samarbejde med de andre tekniske afdelinger
  • Dokumentationsarbejde i.f.t. det lydtekniske (lydplan og back up på egenproduktion)
  • At holde teatret ajour med den teknologiske og tekniske udvikling inden for fagområdet
  • Rådgivning i forbindelse med teatrets investeringer og fondsansøgninger vedrørende lydteknik og andet fælles teknisk udstyr
  • Ansøgninger til KODA

Vi forventer at du:

  • Har en relevant faglig uddannelse eller erfaring med at designe lyd
  • Har en udvidet teknisk forståelse inden for lyd
  • Har erfaring med afvikling af forestillinger
  • Har erfaring med DigiCO og QLab
  • Har erfaring med at arbejde i Logic eller lignende DAW
  • Har mod på at prøve kræfter med nye opgaver og udvikle teaterformatet
  • Er en holdspiller, men kan også tage ejerskab på opgaver og arbejde selvstændigt
  • Har lyst til at indgå i et team, hvor opgaverne også kan variere på tværs af afdelinger
  • Er god til at samarbejde både med dine faste kollegaer og vores mange gæster i huset
  • Er imødekommende og god til at kommunikere
  • Er fleksibel mht. arbejdsopgaver og arbejdstider

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår

Stillingen er en fast stilling med en gennemsnitlig arbejdstid på 37 timer om ugen. Tiltrædelse ønskes hurtigst muligt - gerne den 1. december 2026 og senest den 1. august 2027.

Det er en fordel, hvis du er parat til at bosætte dig i eller i nærheden af Aalborg. Ansættelsen sker i henhold til overenskomsten mellem Dansk Teater og TL. Lønnen forhandles individuelt på baggrund af kvalifikationer og i overensstemmelse med branchens lønniveau.

Ansøgningsfristen er den 15. november 2026 kl. 12.00. Samtaler afholdes løbende på Teater Nordkraft efter aftale.

title: Senior Pricing Manager til Coop Danmark
description:
Senior Pricing Manager til Coop Danmark

Vil du være med til at sætte retningen for pricing i en af Danmarks største

detailvirksomheder?

Pricing er et af de vigtigste konkurrenceparametre i dansk dagligvarehandel. I Coop har vi

et stærkt analytisk fundament i vores prisstyring, men vi har ambitioner om at tage næste

skridt og blive endnu mere datadrevne i vores tilgang. Derfor søger vi en Senior Pricing

Manager, som vil spille en central rolle i udviklingen af vores prisstrategi, styrke vores

analytiske værktøjskasse og omsætte data til bedre kommercielle beslutninger på tværs af

Coop.

Du får en nøgleposition med stor forretningsmæssig indflydelse og betydelige snitflader og

eksponering på tværs af organisationen. Rollen er placeret i Kommerciel Excellence

(KomEx), og du vil indgå i teamet, der arbejder med priser, kampagner og kundeindsigt.

Din rolle

Kommerciel Excellence arbejder på at styrke og professionalisere Coops kommercielle

maskinrum gennem en mere analytisk og datadrevet tilgang til centrale discipliner i

detailhandlen samt løbende optimering af processer og beslutningsgrundlag. Afdelingen

spiller en nøglerolle i at sætte retningen for den kommercielle agenda og sikre, at

strategier omsættes til handling i hele organisationen, fra hovedkontoret til vores cirka

40.000 medarbejdere i mere end 900 butikker. Vi udvikler de kommercielle discipliner og

driver strategiske projekter med bred forankring og tæt samarbejde med både topledelsen

og nøglefunktioner på tværs af Coop.

Som Senior Pricing Manager bliver du faglig leder for vores arbejde med normalpriser. Du

får ansvaret for den kommercielle styring af Coops normalpriser samt den løbende

udvikling og eksekvering af vores prisstrategi, prismodeller og pricing-værktøjer i tæt

samarbejde med kolleger og forretningen. Du bliver den centrale drivkraft i arbejdet med at

sikre, at vores prisbeslutninger bygger på stærke analyser, markedsindsigt og en dyb

forståelse af kundernes adfærd. Samtidig får du mulighed for at præge udviklingen af

fremtidens pricing-funktion i Coop gennem nye metoder, teknologier og mere avanceret

brug af data.

Dine vigtigste ansvarsområder

  • Videreudvikle Coops prisstrategi og sikre en konkurrencedygtig prisposition i

markedet.

  • Drive den kommercielle styring af normalpriser på tværs af kategorier og kæder.
  • Udvikle og forbedre prismodeller, pricing-værktøjer og analytiske metoder.
  • Sikre et stærkt datadrevet beslutningsgrundlag for prisbeslutninger.
  • Analysere priselasticitet, markedsdynamikker, råvareprisudvikling,

konkurrentadfærd og kommercielle performance-drivere.

  • Håndtere særlige markedssituationer, der kræver strukturelle prisjusteringer.
  • Holde sig ajour med relevant lovgivning, markedsudvikling og den offentlige debat

om dagligvarepriser samt omsætte disse indsigter til anbefalinger for Coops

prisstrategi.

  • Udvikle og optimere pricing-processer, governance og beslutningsmodeller.
  • Agere strategisk sparringspartner for kategorichefer, kategoridirektører og de

kommercielle ledelser i Coops kæder.

  • Identificere og realisere muligheder inden for automatisering, avanceret analyse og

AI.

Hvem er du?

Du har sandsynligvis mindst fem års erfaring fra en tilsvarende rolle inden for pricing,

revenue management, category management eller kommerciel analyse. Måske kommer

du fra retail, FMCG, e-commerce eller konsulentbranchen. Det vigtigste er, at du kan

kombinere analytisk dybde med kommerciel forståelse og omsætte komplekse

sammenhænge til konkrete beslutninger og anbefalinger.

**Vi Forestiller Os, At Du

**

  • Har solid erfaring med prisstrategi, prisstyring eller tilsvarende kommercielle

discipliner.

  • Har en relevant kandidatgrad.
  • Har stærke analytiske kompetencer og trives med komplekse problemstillinger, hvor

der skal findes den rette balance mellem kommercielt købmandskab og datadrevet

analyse.

  • Er hands-on og trives med både strategiske og operationelle opgaver.
  • Har stærke Excel-kompetencer og gerne erfaring med Python eller andre værktøjer

til avanceret dataanalyse.

  • Er nysgerrig på nye teknologier og ser muligheder i at anvende AI og

automatisering til at styrke pricing-beslutninger og processer.

  • Er en stærk kommunikator, der evner at omsætte data og analyser til klare

anbefalinger og skabe følgeskab blandt interessenter på tværs af organisationen.

  • Trives i en rolle med mange samarbejdsflader og høje krav til stakeholder

management.

Som person er du ambitiøs, nysgerrig og handlekraftig. Du udfordrer konstruktivt

etablerede sandheder, tager ansvar og motiveres af at skabe synlige resultater gennem

analytisk indsigt, stærkt samarbejde og kommerciel forståelse.

Derfor skal du vælge Coop

Du bliver en del af et fagligt stærkt team af specialister inden for pricing, kampagner og

kundeindsigt, som udgør en central del af Coops Kommerciel Excellence-organisation.

Vi arbejder tæt sammen, hjælper hinanden og tror på, at de bedste løsninger skabes i

fællesskab. Samtidig har vi høje ambitioner for både vores fagområde og vores forretning.

**Hos Os Får Du

**

  • En central specialistrolle med stor synlighed og betydelig forretningsmæssig

indflydelse.

  • Mulighed for at præge prisstrategien i en af Danmarks største detailvirksomheder.
  • Tæt samarbejde med kategorichefer, sortimentschefer og ledelsen på tværs af

Coop.

  • Mulighed for at arbejde med nogle af detailbranchens mest komplekse og

spændende pricing-udfordringer.

  • En arbejdsplads med klare ambitioner om at blive endnu mere datadrevet.
  • Mulighed for at udforske nye teknologier og udvikle fremtidens pricing-værktøjer.
  • Et stærkt fagligt og dynamisk miljø med dygtige og engagerede kolleger.
  • En uformel kultur præget af samarbejde, tillid og højt tempo.
  • Et stærkt socialt fællesskab i afdelingen, hvor vi prioriterer at være sammen – også

om andet end arbejdet.

Arbejdsstedet er på Coops hovedkontor i Albertslund.

Klar til at gøre en forskel?

Hvis du motiveres af at arbejde i krydsfeltet mellem strategi, analyse og kommercielle

beslutninger, og hvis du vil være med til at udvikle næste generation af pricing i Coop, så

glæder vi os til at høre fra dig. Ansøgningsfristen er den 26. november. Vi afholder

samtaler løbende og forbeholder os retten til at lukke rekrutteringen, når den rette kandidat

description:

Ready to contribute to the success of our food solutions company? Apply now!

Location:

5637 Cleveland Ave. - Stevensville, Michigan 49127

Position Summary:

This role is responsible to work independently to bake, fry, package, display and stock deli products; to ensure that the shift contributes to the financial best interest of the store. Additionally, complete all other duties as assigned in a timely manner.

Here’s what you’ll do:

  • Baking and frying duties determined by production schedule - 80% of time.

  • Ability to read, write, comprehend, and interpret documents

  • Detail Oriented
