title: GC Construction Foreman
description:
The JF Petroleum Group stands as a premier leader in the North American fueling infrastructure industry, offering comprehensive turn-key solutions for distribution, construction, and service needs. We serve a diverse clientele including retail fueling stations, commercial and government fleets, and emergency power customers.


The Construction Foreman takes a hands-on leadership role on the job site ensuring prompt, efficient progress of the work. The Foreman determines priorities for work to be done, sometimes on their own initiative and authority, but more often based on needs communicated by management. Pay Range: $28-35/hr, dependent on experience.


Job Duties:

  • Heavy equipment operation - Track hoe, backhoe, (ability to install sheet piling a plus), rental equipment and materials scheduling and call off.
  • Direct and run the project which includes piping and the installation of the tanks and related project materials.
  • Communicate to the Installation Manager any specific requirements for completing the project in a safe, timely, and profitable manner.
  • Communicate with the customer or their onsite representative the requirements or issues that may arise on the job site.
  • Ability to read and understand applicable plans and specification, environmental regulations, fire and building codes that must be enforced on the site.
  • Attend the following meetings (as applicable):
  • Pre-Construction Meetings
  • Safety Meetings
  • Selected training sessions as directed by the Installation Manager
  • Keep accurate daily records on each job. This should include, as a minimum, a record of all tests, inspections, the daily progress on the job, visitors to the job and situations that may affect the schedule in a negative way.
  • Set an example for your crew members by reporting to work on time and in proper uniform.
  • Supervise the daily activities of the crew.
  • Plan for tomorrow.
  • Take opportunities to train the crew so that each member is able to take on increasing responsibilities.
  • Enforce all mandatory safety rules:
  • Be aware of potential hazards and correct any of these situations.
  • Require the use of the proper personal protective equipment by all crew members and subcontractors.
  • Hold weekly job-site safety meetings.
  • Ensure a positive Company image including the following:
  • The personal appearance of each crew member should be clean and in compliance with Company Policy.
  • Each vehicle must be clean and orderly.
  • The job site should be kept orderly and free of safety hazards. Treat the site as if it is your own property.
  • The job site sign should be kept clean and in good repair.
  • The conduct of each crew member should be professional and courteous.
  • Maintain all vehicles in compliance with departmental preventive maintenance policies. Do not allow unsafe conditions to exist on the vehicles. Vehicles should be washed and cleaned weekly. Operate all vehicles in a safe manner.
  • Work will include after-hours
  • Able to work in all weather conditions – significant portion of the work is done outdoors
  • Willing to travel, up to 50-60% of the time

title: Creative Partnerships & Social Intern
description:
GUBI is a modern design company offering a wide variety of luxury furniture, lighting, and interior objects for both residential and commercial settings. With a strong global presence, GUBI’s headquarters and showroom are located in Copenhagen, Denmark.

About the position

Do you have a good eye for design, interiors and photography, and an interest in how a design house collaborates with creative voices? As GUBI’s Creative Partnerships & Social Intern, you’ll help build two new programmes from the start. One is a creative partnerships programme with photographers, stylists, writers and storytellers whose perspective brings something new to the conversation around design. The other is an affiliate programme with creators across Europe. You’ll work closely with the programme lead and collaborate with colleagues across Marketing and E-commerce, helping keep collaborations running smoothly from first contact to published content.

Key responsibilities

  • Support outreach to new creators and partners and help onboard them into the affiliate programme, including preparing agreements and briefs.
  • Coordinate gifting and product seeding, from approval through stock checks, shipping and follow-up.
  • Support the content calendar and our social channels, and bring your own ideas to the table.
  • Help create briefs for creative collaborations and attend shoots when they take place in Copenhagen.
  • Maintain an overview of product shipments, content received and partnership deliverables.
  • Support the preparation of monthly reports on reach, engagement and affiliate sales.
  • Support other social and partnership projects as needed.

Qualifications

  • A good eye for design, interiors and photography, with solid design knowledge and references.
  • You follow creators and design media, and can identify content and potential partners relevant to GUBI.
  • Comfortable working with spreadsheets and basic performance data.
  • Experience with Notion, Figma and social platforms is an advantage.
  • Video editing or graphic design skills are a bonus, but not required.

Language skills

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

Personal attributes

  • Organised and very detail-oriented, with a structured approach to tasks.
  • Proactive in following up to keep collaborations moving, and willing to ask questions along the way.
  • Comfortable managing several tasks at once and adapting when priorities change.
  • Curious, open-minded and collaborative.

title: Customer Experience Tech Advocate
description:
Better Careers Start Here!


Join a company that fosters career growth through formal job training and strategic leadership development programs. The amazing career opportunities at Hunter Communications are fueled by our rapidly expanding, state-of-the-art fiber internet and world-class customer service.


At Hunter Communications, all employees are provided a benefit package including medical, dental, vision, disability coverage, life insurance, and an employee assistance program.   • Schedule technician appointments for issues requiring an on-site visit

  • Escalate complex issues to Tier 2 with a detailed handoff if unsolvable

Tier 2 Responsibilities:

  • Handle escalated and complex technical issues that go beyond Tier 1 scope
  • Diagnose slow speeds, intermittent connectivity, packet loss, latency, and signal issues using network diagnostic tools
  • Troubleshoot Wi-Fi performance, device compatibility, DNS resolution, VoIP, and more
  • Analyze signal levels and identify root causes of advanced network problems
  • Coordinate with field technicians and cross-functional teams for on-site resolution
  • Serve as a knowledge resource and support escalation point for Tier 1 team members
  • Maintain thorough and accurate documentation on all escalated cases

title: Expo
description:
Job Description – Expo

Job Title: ExpoReports to: General ManagerEmployment Type: Full-Time / Non-ExemptEligible for Tips: Yes – Crew Level 3

About Olive & Finch Collective

Olive & Finch Collective is a Denver-based hospitality group committed to fresh, chef-driven meals, exceptional guest experiences, and a people-first culture. Since opening in 2013, our growing portfolio now includes restaurants, neighborhood cafés, a full-service bakeshop, a robust catering and events division, retail and grab-and-go operations, and multiple locations at Denver International Airport. At Olive & Finch, we believe in inclusive leadership, sustainable growth, and nourishing both our guests and our teams.

Position Summary

The Expo is responsible for coordinating the flow of food from the kitchen to the guest, ensuring every order is accurate, beautifully presented, and meets Olive & Finch standards. This role performs all FOH Crew responsibilities and leads the expo station, verifying kitchen output against build guides, assembling to-go and catering orders, and communicating with the BOH team to maintain smooth service. As a Crew Level 3 position, the Expo is key to quality control and overall guest satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform all FOH Crew responsibilities including greeting guests, bussing tables, running food and beverages, and maintaining a clean and organized dining area.
  • Lead the expo station during service, ensuring it is fully stocked, organized, and running efficiently.
  • Verify that food coming out of the kitchen matches Olive & Finch build guides for accuracy and presentation.
  • Assemble and check all to-go and catering orders for completeness and quality before they leave the restaurant.
  • Communicate clearly with the kitchen team to ensure timing, accuracy, and smooth ticket flow.
  • Maintain cleanliness and organization of the expo station throughout the shift.
  • Work closely with FOH and BOH teams to deliver a seamless guest experience.
  • Always Uphold Olive & Finch service and quality standards.

Qualifications

  • Previous experience in a restaurant expo or food-running role preferred but not required.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to multitask under pressure.
  • Excellent communication skills for coordinating between FOH and BOH teams.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment while maintaining accuracy and composure.
  • Must be able to stand for extended periods and lift up to 25 lbs.
  • Availability to work mornings, evenings, weekends, and holidays as needed.

Competencies / Core Values

  • Guest-focused and service-oriented.
  • Highly organized and detail-driven.
  • Collaborative and calm under pressure.
  • Reliable, punctual, and committed to excellence.
  • Positive attitude and willingness to learn.

Reporting Structure

Reports to the General Manager. This position does not have direct reports.

Work Environment & Physical Requirements

This is a hands-on, fast-paced position requiring extended periods of standing, walking, and working at the expo line. Must be able to bend, lift, and move quickly to support service. Shifts may include mornings, evenings, weekends, and holidays.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Hourly pay + tip share (Crew Level 3).
  • Meal discounts, flexible scheduling, and opportunities for advancement.

EEO & At-Will Statement

Olive & Finch Collective is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment with Olive & Finch is at-will, meaning either the employee or the company may terminate employment at any time, with or without notice or cause. This job description is not an employment contract and may be updated as business needs evolve.

title: PGA Associate - Account Management, Lodging
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.


Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Introduction to team


The Partner Growth & Agility, Competitiveness Agility Team primary responsibility is to ensure that Expedia Group’s hotels, and all accommodations types in our high demand APAC markets have great rates and room types available for the Expedia Group travelers (including travelers from B2B Demand Partners) at all times.


The Partner Growth & Agility, Competitiveness Agility Team will also continuously work with Expedia Group’s hotel and accommodation partners to help them improve their end-to-end competitive position taking the most from their participation in the Expedia marketplace.


You will work as part of a team, with the primary goal of improving the conversion rate for our high-demand markets. You will closely work in collaboration with other in-market account management teams to ensure the right and competitive conditions across high demand markets and ultimately provide the best product on EG-branded sites as well as those of our B2B Demand partners.



In this role, you will:

  • This is a predominantly phone-based role, and you will be reaching out to a portfolio of existing accommodation partners each day. You will closely work with these hotel partners to:
  • Optimize rate and availability competitiveness on the Expedia platform to increase customer conversion
  • Secure additional lodging rates and availability information over high demand and compression periods to satisfy customers’ pressing needs
  • Coordinate with other account management teams to secure an aligned and effective level of competitiveness across high-demand Asia Pacific markets
  • Educate hotel partners on the self-service features available on Expedia Partner Central to make them independent in managing all the core aspects of our marketplace and make the mutual business more sustainable over the partners’ lifecycle
  • Re-establish core fundamentals to re-engage with dormant hotel partners
  • Take time to shop our sites as a traveler would to identify issues that may not have been identified by our automated shopping tools and help to identify additional root causes of uncompetitiveness

Experience and qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in a related field; or Equivalent related professional experience
  • Native proficiency in Japanese
  • Business-level proficiency in English
  • 1-3 years of experience in hotel sales/revenue management, account management, inside sales or business development preferred
  • Able to work independently as well as be a strong team worker, ensuring the whole team wins
  • Demonstrate ability to work based on a variety targets, goals and/or strategic objectives set by the leadership team
  • Appetite for innovative technology, fast-changing business environment, robust data driven analysis
  • Presents ideas and directives clearly and persuasively; actively listens when spoken/presented to
  • Ability to effectively communicate to various levels and through a variety of communication channels
  • Ability to handle objection, secure commitments and be resilient
  • Possesses outstanding listening, investigating and influencing skills
  • Hungry, determined, motivated, willing to take action and results-focused
  • Organization and time management skills, rigor, attention to details
  • Proven follow-up/persistence when facing challenging situations
  • Ability to multi-task effectively and be able to change gears quickly without skipping a beat
  • Ability to perform under pressure and think on your feet in a fast-paced environment
  • Open to feedback for continuous improvement
  • Relationship builder; earns the confidence of others
  • Bridges and sustains solid partnerships based on mutual support through a collaborative style

Accommodation requests

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job_accommodation.


About Expedia Group

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.


Important notice

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is .


Equal Opportunity

Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.

title: Principal Software Engineer
description:
• Lead our toughest engineering challenges and set technical direction
  • Drive engineering excellence through standards, patterns and guardrails
  • Shape what’s next in AI augmented engineering and secure, accelerated delivery

We are establishing Principal Engineering within Software Engineering at NZ Transport Agency | Waka Kotahi (NZTA), bringing together deep technical expertise, strategic influence and hands on leadership. You’ll work across teams and platforms, tackling complex challenges, shaping long term engineering direction and growing technical capability across NZTA.

Te Whiwhinga mahi | The opportunity

Software Engineering is at the heart of end-to-end digital delivery at NZTA, and we are establishing Principal Engineering to strengthen technical leadership across our teams, platforms and delivery.


As a Principal Software Engineer, you’ll combine strategic thinking with deep, hands-on technical expertise across our frontend, backend, mobile and integration engineering landscape. You’ll stay close to delivery, stepping into complex engineering challenges while influencing longer term technical direction.


You’ll also be a trusted technical advisor to the Chapter Lead, with the opportunity to influence the future of Software Engineering at NZTA, grow technical capability and advance our ambition for engineering excellence, AI augmented engineering and accelerated delivery with a strong security posture.


We’re a community of software engineers who help each other grow, build excellent software and recognise that engineering is a team sport. We never stand still. We are always learning and always improving.

You will:

  • Provide hands on technical leadership across complex, high impact engineering challenges
  • Lead the development and adoption of engineering standards, patterns, guardrails and reusable approaches
  • Lead the evolution of AI augmented engineering, identifying, proving and scaling approaches that improve how we design, build, test and deliver software
  • Bring systems thinking across frontend, backend, mobile and integration engineering
  • Influence software strategy, technical direction and significant engineering decisions across teams and platforms
  • Provide enterprise level technical design leadership and proportionate assurance for significant or high risk work
  • Guide detailed technical decisions, balancing quality, cost, security, resilience and long term sustainability
  • Mentor engineers from graduate through to senior level, growing technical capability and future technical leaders across the chapter
  • Build alignment across Engineering, Architecture, Security, Platforms, Product and delivery teams, navigating dependencies and competing priorities
  • Champion DevSecOps, automation and shift left security across the SDLC

You will find out more about the role the Position Description.

Ko koe tēnei | About you

You’ll be an accomplished technical leader in software engineering, combining deep technical credibility with strategic thinking, exceptional communication and the ability to influence across teams and disciplines.


You’ll be future focused, curious and genuinely passionate about engineering. We’re looking for someone who brings energy and ideas, inspires others and can turn emerging opportunities, particularly AI, into practical engineering outcomes.


To be successful in this role, you will bring:

  • Deep software engineering expertise and excellent analytical and problem-solving capability, with a track record of tackling complex engineering challenges
  • Experience establishing and embedding engineering standards, patterns, guardrails, Golden Paths and reusable approaches
  • A future focused vision for AI augmented engineering, with the curiosity and technical leadership to experiment, prove and scale new approaches
  • Broad technical expertise across modern software engineering, with the depth and judgement to lead across backend, frontend, integration, data and cloud technologies, including environments such as Java, Spring Boot, React, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub and GitHub Actions.
  • A strong understanding of modern SDLC and DevSecOps practices, embedding security, automation and assurance throughout the engineering lifecycle rather than treating them as separate activities
  • Exceptional communication and influencing skills, with the ability to simplify complexity, tell a compelling technical story and build alignment without relying on authority
  • Systems thinking and sound technical judgement, with the ability to understand dependencies, evaluate trade offs and make balanced decisions across teams and platforms
  • A track record of mentoring engineers and developing future technical leaders, with the energy and enthusiasm to grow capability across the chapter
  • A growth mindset and commitment to continuous learning, openly sharing knowledge, challenging thinking and always looking for better ways to engineer software

You will demonstrate knowledge of, or a willingness to gain an understanding of Te Ao Māori and promote tikanga and Te Reo Māori. You will also have knowledge of, or a willingness to gain an appreciation of Te Tiriti o Waitangi (the Treaty of Waitangi) as it applies in the public service.

Mō mātou |About Us

The Chief Technology Office (CTO) is a strategic business enabler within NZTA, providing the digital skills, capabilities, platforms and leadership needed to support our operational performance, regulatory responsibilities and future transport vision.

The CTO helps ensure our digital investments, platforms and services align with organisational priorities and deliver value across NZTA. It plays an important role in enabling efficient service delivery, improving customer experience, managing risk and supporting long term planning.

As part of Te Aukaha | Digital, you’ll contribute to improving our services and decision making and providing modern, fit for purpose digital, information and technology solutions for our people, partners and customers.

You’ll be part of our Engineering Chapter, providing Principal level leadership for Software Engineering and shaping the technical direction, modern engineering practices and capability that support digital delivery across NZTA.

Ka whiwhi koe i te aha | What you will get in return

This is an opportunity to be at the heart of Software Engineering at NZTA, with enterprise-wide influence on how we design, build and deliver software that matters to New Zealand.


You’ll influence engineering from concept and technical strategy through to working software, shaping technology direction, engineering quality and secure delivery. You’ll have the autonomy to challenge thinking, raise the engineering bar and help us realise the potential of AI augmented engineering.


In addition, you'll benefit from:

  • Flexible working arrangements that support work-life balance
  • Five weeks annual leave
  • Income Protection and Critical Illness Insurance for permanent employees
  • Professional development and career growth opportunities
  • A collaborative and inclusive culture committed to delivering meaningful outcomes for New Zealanders


You’ll join a diverse, high performing engineering community where you can keep growing while growing others. If you want to solve important problems, influence engineering at scale and build digital services New Zealanders rely on, we’d love to hear from you.

Ready to make your mark on Software Engineering at NZTA? If you want to tackle hard problems, raise the engineering bar, grow others and help shape what comes next, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Applied Compression Aero Intern
description:
Be a part of our mission! As a world leader in creating comfortable, sustainable, and efficient climate solutions for buildings, homes and transportation, it's our responsibility to put the planet first. For us at Trane Technologies, and through our businesses including Trane® and Thermo King, sustainability is not just how we do business—it is our business. Do you dare to look at the world's challenges and see impactful possibilities? Do you want to contribute to making a better future? If the answer is yes, we invite you to consider joining us in boldly challenging what's possible for a sustainable world.

Learn about our benefits designed for you to Thrive at work and at home.

We boldly go.

Where is the work:

On-Site (5 days)

What's in it for you:
At Trane Technologies® we Challenge Possible. Our brands – including Trane® and Thermo King® - create access to cooling and comfort in buildings and homes, transport and protect food and perishables, connect customers to elevated performance with less environmental impact, dramatically reduce energy demands and carbon emissions, and innovate with a better world in mind. We boldly challenge what’s possible for a sustainable world.


This is an Engineering Intern position running from May 2027 through August 2027.

This internship will be with the Trane Technologies Applied Compression Engineering Group located in La Crosse, Wisconsin. We are responsible for the analysis, design, testing, and qualification of Trane positive displacement and centrifugal compressors. You will be given a variety of assignments to experience the theoretical and practical side of engineering. Most activity will take place in an office environment with some time spent in the Trane laboratory. Limited travel to suppliers and customers may also be required, depending on the assignment.


What you will do:

  • Core Job Responsibilities (others may be added):
    • Perform engineering analysis and modeling to support design choices and predict compressor performance.
    • Support lab testing and data analysis to verify that compressors meet requirements.
    • Create and maintain engineering documentation, including technical reports, drawings, and specifications.
    • Provide technical support to laboratory technicians, manufacturing engineering, suppliers and operations.
    • Collaborate with team to complete engineering design projects.
  • Key Competencies:
    • Demonstrated ability to take initiative (minimum of one example in the *last four years such as: previous employment, school club officer, sports team captain, resident advisor, etc.)
    • Strong work ethic and positive attitude.
    • Good communication and teamwork skills.

What you will bring:

  • MINIMUM qualifications
    • Pursuing Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering (Sophomore or Junior standing) or related field
    • Overall 3.0 GPA or above.
    • Coursework completed in Thermodynamics and Mechanical System Design.

$25.50

Hourly

No

No

title: Customer Experience Tech Advocate
description:
Better Careers Start Here!


Join a company that fosters career growth through formal job training and strategic leadership development programs. The amazing career opportunities at Hunter Communications are fueled by our rapidly expanding, state-of-the-art fiber internet and world-class customer service.


At Hunter Communications, all employees are provided a benefit package including medical, dental, vision, disability coverage, life insurance, and an employee assistance program. ABOUT THE ROLE

Are you passionate about technology and delivering exceptional customer experiences? WHAT YOU WILL DO

Tier 1 Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the first point of contact for inbound customer calls, chats, and tickets
  • Identify and troubleshoot basic internet connectivity issues — slow speeds, dropped connections, equipment reboots, and Wi-Fi setup
  • Verify service outages, check account status, and guide customers through power cycling and device reconnection
  • Confirm SSIDs, passwords, and proper modem/router connections
  • Schedule technician appointments for issues requiring an on-site visit

  • Escalate complex issues to Tier 2 with a detailed handoff if unsolvable

Tier 2 Responsibilities:

  • Handle escalated and complex technical issues that go beyond Tier 1 scope
  • Diagnose slow speeds, intermittent connectivity, packet loss, latency, and signal issues using network diagnostic tools
  • Troubleshoot Wi-Fi performance, device compatibility, DNS resolution, VoIP, and more
  • Analyze signal levels and identify root causes of advanced network problems
  • Coordinate with field technicians and cross-functional teams for on-site resolution
  • Serve as a knowledge resource and support escalation point for Tier 1 team members
  • Maintain thorough and accurate documentation on all escalated cases

title: Goods-in & Stock Control Manager
description:
Passionate about food production, logistics, and operational excellence? At Glanmore Foods, we are committed to delivering high-quality, nutritious meals to schools across Ireland. We are looking for a Goods In & Stock Control Manager to join our growing team on a full-time, permanent basis and play a key role in ensuring the efficient management of stock, inventory, and supply chain operations.

As a Goods In & Stock Control Manager, you will be responsible for the efficient, accurate, and compliant management of goods-in, stock control, inventory management, and ordering activities across our operation. You will work collaboratively with production, consolidation, and logistics teams to ensure stock accuracy, product availability, regulatory compliance, and seamless operational performance.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead and manage all goods-in activities, ensuring deliveries are received, inspected, recorded, and stored in line with food safety and quality standards.
  • Maintain accurate inventory records and oversee stock control processes, ensuring high levels of stock accuracy and traceability.
  • Manage stock ordering and replenishment to support production requirements while minimising waste and stock holding costs.
  • Implement and monitor FIFO and FEFO stock rotation procedures across all inventory categories.
  • Conduct regular stock counts, investigate discrepancies, and implement corrective actions to improve stock accuracy.
  • Build strong working relationships with production, consolidation, and logistics teams to ensure seamless operational performance.
  • Ensure compliance with food safety, health & safety, HACCP, and company policies at all times.
  • Lead, coach, and develop warehouse and stock control teams, driving a culture of accountability, safety, and continuous improvement.

About You:

  • Previous management experience within food manufacturing, foodservice, warehousing, logistics, or FMCG environments.
  • Strong understanding of stock management, inventory control, warehouse operations, and supply chain processes.
  • Working knowledge of ERP, WMS, and stock management systems, with strong Microsoft Excel skills.
  • Good understanding of HACCP, food safety, traceability requirements, and stock rotation principles.
  • Excellent leadership and people management skills, with the ability to motivate and develop high-performing teams.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, capable of identifying trends and implementing effective solutions.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate across multiple departments.
  • Highly organised, adaptable, and capable of managing competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Some of the benefits we offer:

As well as a competitive salary, we also have a large range of other benefits, such as

  • Discounts on brands across the Island of Ireland (restaurants, high street stores, hotels, day out venues, gyms, golf courses and many more)
  • Flexible working to support work life balance
  • Free parking at the office
  • Career Pathways to support career progression and/or skills development
  • Learning & development programs available for personal and professional development & growth
  • Access to wellness programs to promote mental health and wellbeing of our colleagues
  • Employee Assistance Program to guide and support our employees
  • Exciting appreciation days

And many more..

About Us:

Glanmore Foods is apart of the Compass Group, located in Blanchardstown, Dublin. At Compass Ireland, our people are our business. When you join the Compass Group you will be joining a supportive network of incredible individuals, each united by their passion for going the extra mile for the organisations we partner with. We are building a team who care about providing a great customer experience and want to grow and develop as we do. We are dedicated to investing in every colleague joining us and pride ourselves on being an equal opportunity employer; we celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive environment for all our colleagues. We consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Please review our Privacy Notice for details on how we maintain protect and why your personal data collected when you apply for a job with Glanmore Foods. We will not retain any CV’s or job applications for longer than necessary.
